metadata.label: 领域定位
metadata.value: 该研究属于泛癌空间转录组、三级淋巴结构成熟、计算病理和免疫治疗患者分层研究。

qa.question: 研究解决什么问题？
qa.answer: 三级淋巴结构的存在通常与抗肿瘤免疫相关，但不同成熟阶段、相对肿瘤的位置以及这些特征在不同癌种中的临床意义尚缺乏统一框架。研究构建泛癌空间图谱，并开发可从常规H&E规模化识别TLS状态的AI体系。

qa.question: 核心数据是什么？
qa.answer: 研究统一分析12个癌种的340张空间转录组切片和255名患者，识别695个空间转录组TLS；随后在10个独立队列的3,071张H&E全切片中识别和分类25,088个TLS，并结合超高通量空间成像、单细胞空间数据和治疗队列验证。

qa.question: 模型或分析的输入与输出是什么？
qa.answer: 空间流程输入全切片空间转录组与H&E，通过TLS基因特征、无监督分割和肿瘤距离计算输出TLS边界、早期/初级/次级成熟状态及肿瘤内/周围/远端位置；AI流程输入H&E WSI，输出TLS检测和成熟分类，并汇总为患者级成熟组成评分。

qa.question: 主要生物学发现是什么？
qa.answer: TLS从早期聚集体到具有生发中心的成熟结构形成连续谱，并伴随B/T细胞分区、滤泡树突细胞网络、趋化因子及干扰素程序增强。肿瘤内TLS附近富集抗原呈递和IFN反应，远离TLS的区域更富集MYC、G2/M、EMT等增殖和侵袭程序。

qa.question: 主要临床结果是什么？
qa.answer: 基于肿瘤内不同成熟TLS比例建立的复合评分，在多个癌种和治疗背景中比仅判断TLS有无或仅使用主导成熟状态更稳定地分层生存和治疗反应。

qa.question: 最重要的限制是什么？
qa.answer: 不同癌种的空间样本量和组织取样深度不均，部分癌种TLS稀少；AI标签来自空间推断而非所有病例的直接免疫染色，临床分析主要为回顾性，距离梯度和成熟状态与肿瘤程序之间仍不能证明因果。

overview.method: 统一处理340张空间转录组切片 → 基于TLS特征识别、分割并判断成熟与空间位置 → 比较细胞组成、转录程序和肿瘤距离梯度 → 用高通量和单细胞空间平台正交验证 → 训练H&E TLS检测与成熟分类模型 → 在3,071张WSI扩展 → 构建成熟组成复合评分并验证结局
overview.story: 文章把TLS从二元有无标志物改写为具有成熟度和空间位置的免疫生态单元。空间组学揭示成熟过程中免疫组织化增强，并显示肿瘤程序随TLS距离形成梯度；AI将这些特征扩展到常规病理大队列，患者级复合评分则把TLS异质性转化为可验证的临床分层指标。

sections.title_zh: 引言

english.text: Tertiary lymphoid structures (TLSs) are ectopic immune aggregates that arise within tumors and regulate antitumor immunity. Although TLS presence has been associated with enhanced immune activity and improved outcomes in several settings, their maturation states, spatial locations relative to tumors, and context-dependent associations have not been systematically characterized at a pan-cancer scale, limiting a unified view of TLS biology and clinical utility. We asked how TLS maturation and spatial context relate to local immune programs and tumor cell states and whether these features can be quantified from routine histopathology. To address this, we combined spatial transcriptomics (ST) with deep learning applied to hematoxylin and eosin (H&E) whole-slide images (WSIs), building an atlas of TLS diversity across human cancers and a deployable framework that translates TLS spatial features into patient stratification.

chinese.text: 三级淋巴结构（TLS）是肿瘤内产生并调节抗肿瘤免疫的异位免疫聚集体。尽管 TLS 的存在在多种情况下与增强的免疫活性和改善的结果相关，但它们的成熟状态、相对于肿瘤的空间位置以及背景依赖性关联尚未在泛癌范围内系统地表征，限制了 TLS 生物学和临床实用性的统一观点。我们询问 TLS 成熟和空间背景如何与局部免疫程序和肿瘤细胞状态相关，以及这些特征是否可以从常规组织病理学中量化。为了解决这个问题，我们将空间转录组学 (ST) 与应用于苏木精和伊红 (H&E) 全幻灯片图像 (WSI) 的深度学习相结合，构建了人类癌症的 TLS 多样性图谱，以及将 TLS 空间特征转化为患者分层的可部署框架。

source_fragments: Tertiary lymphoid structures (TLSs) are ectopic immune aggregates that arise within tumors and regulate antitumor immunity. Although TLS presence has been associated with enhanced immune activity and improved outcomes in several settings, their maturation states, spatial locations relative to tumors, and context-dependent associations have not been systematically characterized at a pan-cancer scale, limiting a unified view of TLS biology and clinical utility. We asked how TLS maturation and spatial context relate to local immune programs and tumor cell states and whether these features can be quantified from routine histopathology. To address this, we combined spatial transcriptomics (ST) with deep learning applied to hematoxylin and eosin (H&E) whole-slide images (WSIs), building an atlas of TLS diversity across human cancers and a deployable framework that translates TLS spatial features into patient stratification.

sections.title_zh: 研究依据

english.text: Whole-transcriptome spatial profiling across entire tissue sections enables unbiased identification of TLS niches, maturation trajectories, and spatial context relative to tumor regions [intratumoral (IT), peritumoral (PT), distal-tumoral (DT)], avoiding marker-limited and region of interest–constrained analyses. We uniformly processed 340 ST sections and paired histology, then extended to 3071 WSIs using an artificial intelligence (AI)–enabled framework to detect and classify TLSs at scale. We hypothesized that TLS maturation state and spatial context would be associated with distinct local immune programs and TLS proximity–linked tumor pathway patterns and that a composition-based score (capturing early, primary, or secondary TLS states and their relative proportions) would outperform binary “TLS present or absent” or dominant-state heuristics for prognosis. Cross-cohort analyses, orthogonal validations (including ultrahigh-plex imaging and single-cell spatial profiling), and sensitivity tests were used to assess robustness and generalizability.

chinese.text: 整个组织切片的全转录组空间分析能够公正地识别 TLS 生态位、成熟轨迹和相对于肿瘤区域 [瘤内 (IT)、瘤周 (PT)、远端肿瘤 (DT)] 的空间背景，避免标记物限制和感兴趣区域限制的分析。我们统一处理 340 个 ST 切片和配对组织学，然后使用人工智能 (AI) 支持的框架扩展到 3071 个 WSI，以大规模检测和分类 TLS。我们假设 TLS 成熟状态和空间背景与不同的局部免疫程序和 TLS 邻近相关肿瘤通路模式相关，并且基于成分的评分（捕获早期、初级或次级 TLS 状态及其相对比例）将优于二元“TLS 存在或不存在”或显性状态启发式的预后。使用跨队列分析、正交验证（包括超高重成像和单细胞空间分析）和敏感性测试来评估稳健性和普遍性。

source_fragments: Whole-transcriptome spatial profiling across entire tissue sections enables unbiased identification of TLS niches, maturation trajectories, and spatial context relative to tumor regions [intratumoral (IT), peritumoral (PT), distal-tumoral (DT)], avoiding marker-limited and region of interest–constrained analyses. We uniformly processed 340 ST sections and paired histology, then extended to 3071 WSIs using an artificial intelligence (AI)–enabled framework to detect and classify TLSs at scale. We hypothesized that TLS maturation state and spatial context would be associated with distinct local immune programs and TLS proximity–linked tumor pathway patterns and that a composition-based score (capturing early, primary, or secondary TLS states and their relative proportions) would outperform binary “TLS present or absent” or dominant-state heuristics for prognosis. Cross-cohort analyses, orthogonal validations (including ultrahigh-plex imaging and single-cell spatial profiling), and sensitivity tests were used to assess robustness and generalizability.

sections.title_zh: 结果摘要

english.text: Across 12 cancer types, we profiled TLSs including TLSs resolved by ST and identified from WSIs. TLSs varied substantially in prevalence, maturation, and spatial distribution across cancer types. TLSs spanned a maturation continuum [early (E-TLSs), primary follicle–like (P-TLSs), and secondary follicle–like (S-TLSs)]

chinese.text: 在 12 种癌症类型中，我们分析了 TLS，包括通过 ST 解析的 TLS 和从 WSI 中识别的 TLS。不同癌症类型的 TLS 在患病率、成熟度和空间分布方面存在很大差异。 TLS 跨越成熟连续体 [早期 (E-TLS)、初级卵泡样 (P-TLSs) 和次级卵泡样 (S-TLSs)]

source_fragments: Across 12 cancer types, we profiled TLSs including TLSs resolved by ST and identified from WSIs. TLSs varied substantially in prevalence, maturation, and spatial distribution across cancer types. TLSs spanned a maturation continuum [early (E-TLSs), primary follicle–like (P-TLSs), and secondary follicle–like (S-TLSs)]

english.text: Pan-cancer TLS atlas and AI-enabled patient stratification. We built a pan-cancer TLS atlas and developed AI-enabled frameworks to detect and phenotype TLSs. Across 12 cancers, we mapped TLS location, maturation states, and tumor-signaling gradients. A maturation-aware composite score stratifies patients across clinical contexts. GCB, germinal center B cell; DC, dendritic cell; FDC, follicular dendritic cell.

chinese.text: 泛癌 TLS 图谱和人工智能支持的患者分层。我们构建了泛癌 TLS 图谱，并开发了支持 AI 的框架来检测 TLS 并对其进行表型分析。在 12 种癌症中，我们绘制了 TLS 位置、成熟状态和肿瘤信号梯度图。成熟感知综合评分根据临床情况对患者进行分层。 GCB，生发中心B细胞； DC，树突状细胞； FDC，滤泡树突状细胞。

source_fragments: Pan-cancer TLS atlas and AI-enabled patient stratification. We built a pan-cancer TLS atlas and developed AI-enabled frameworks to detect and phenotype TLSs. Across 12 cancers, we mapped TLS location, maturation states, and tumor-signaling gradients. A maturation-aware composite score stratifies patients across clinical contexts. GCB, germinal center B cell; DC, dendritic cell; FDC, follicular dendritic cell.

english.text: and occupied distinct spatial niches relative to tumors. Maturation was associated with coordinated immune organization: B and T cell zoning and activation, follicular dendritic cell networks, cytokine and chemokine signaling, and interferon (IFN)–related responses. Spatial analyses around intratumoral TLSs (IT-TLSs) revealed distance-dependent tumor pathway gradients: Immune activation and antigen-presentation programs (e.g., IFN-α and IFN-γ responses and MHC class II signatures) were enriched in tumor regions closest to TLSs and attenuated with distance, whereas proliferative and invasive programs (e.g., MYC targets, G2/M cell-cycle programs, epithelial-mesenchymal transition, and related oncogenic pathways) were relatively higher in TLS-distal tumor regions, highlighting spatial coupling between TLS niches and tumor programs. These findings were supported by single-cell–resolved spatial multimodal profiling. To scale beyond ST, we trained an AI framework to detect TLSs and predict maturation states directly from H&E WSIs and evaluated it across additional The Cancer Genome Atlas and independent therapy cohorts. We distilled these spatial features of TLSs into a maturation-aware composite score capturing within-tumor TLS state composition that robustly stratifies patients by survival and treatment response across cancers and treatment contexts.

chinese.text: 并占据相对于肿瘤不同的空间生态位。成熟与协调的免疫组织有关：B 细胞和 T 细胞分区和激活、滤泡树突细胞网络、细胞因子和趋化因子信号传导以及干扰素 (IFN) 相关反应。肿瘤内 TLS (IT-TLS) 周围的空间分析揭示了距离依赖性肿瘤途径梯度：免疫激活和抗原呈递程序（例如 IFN-α 和 IFN-γ 反应以及 MHC II 类特征）在最靠近 TLS 的肿瘤区域中丰富，并随着距离的增加而减弱，而增殖和侵袭性程序（例如 MYC 靶点、G2/M 细胞周期程序、上皮间质转化和相关致癌途径）在 TLS 远端肿瘤区域相对较高，突出了 TLS 生态位和肿瘤程序之间的空间耦合。这些发现得到了单细胞解析的空间多模态分析的支持。为了超越 ST，我们训练了一个 AI 框架来检测 TLS 并直接从 H&E WSI 预测成熟状态，并在其他癌症基因组图谱和独立治疗队列中对其进行评估。我们将 TLS 的这些空间特征提炼成一个成熟感知的综合评分，捕获肿瘤内 TLS 状态的组成，该评分根据癌症和治疗背景下的生存和治疗反应对患者进行稳健的分层。

source_fragments: and occupied distinct spatial niches relative to tumors. Maturation was associated with coordinated immune organization: B and T cell zoning and activation, follicular dendritic cell networks, cytokine and chemokine signaling, and interferon (IFN)–related responses. Spatial analyses around intratumoral TLSs (IT-TLSs) revealed distance-dependent tumor pathway gradients: Immune activation and antigen-presentation programs (e.g., IFN-α and IFN-γ responses and MHC class II signatures) were enriched in tumor regions closest to TLSs and attenuated with distance, whereas proliferative and invasive programs (e.g., MYC targets, G2/M cell-cycle programs, epithelial-mesenchymal transition, and related oncogenic pathways) were relatively higher in TLS-distal tumor regions, highlighting spatial coupling between TLS niches and tumor programs. These findings were supported by single-cell–resolved spatial multimodal profiling. To scale beyond ST, we trained an AI framework to detect TLSs and predict maturation states directly from H&E WSIs and evaluated it across additional The Cancer Genome Atlas and independent therapy cohorts. We distilled these spatial features of TLSs into a maturation-aware composite score capturing within-tumor TLS state composition that robustly stratifies patients by survival and treatment response across cancers and treatment contexts.

sections.title_zh: 结论摘要

english.text: TLSs are spatially organized, heterogeneous immune hubs whose maturation and spatial context are linked to local immune organization, tumor pathway gradients, and patient outcomes. By uniting whole-section ST with AI on standard WSIs, we provide both a pan-cancer atlas of TLS diversity and a practical route to scalable, histology-deployable TLS profiling. The composition-based TLS composite score is positioned for prospective evaluation as a stratifier or endpoint in immuno-oncology trials and may help guide strategies aimed at promoting beneficial TLS states. Future work should incorporate longitudinal sampling under therapy, improved subclass or isotype-resolved antibody profiling as platforms mature, and functional perturbation to test causal mechanisms and refine TLS-informed clinical decision-making. 

chinese.text: TLS 是空间组织的异质免疫中心，其成熟度和空间背景与局部免疫组织、肿瘤途径梯度和患者结果相关。通过将全切片 ST 与标准 WSI 上的 AI 相结合，我们提供了 TLS 多样性的泛癌图谱和可扩展、可组织学部署的 TLS 分析的实用途径。基于成分的 TLS 综合评分可作为免疫肿瘤学试验中的分层或终点进行前瞻性评估，并可能有助于指导旨在促进有益 TLS 状态的策略。未来的工作应包括治疗下的纵向采样、随着平台的成熟改进亚类或同种型解析的抗体分析，以及功能扰动以测试因果机制并完善基于 TLS 的临床决策。 

source_fragments: TLSs are spatially organized, heterogeneous immune hubs whose maturation and spatial context are linked to local immune organization, tumor pathway gradients, and patient outcomes. By uniting whole-section ST with AI on standard WSIs, we provide both a pan-cancer atlas of TLS diversity and a practical route to scalable, histology-deployable TLS profiling. The composition-based TLS composite score is positioned for prospective evaluation as a stratifier or endpoint in immuno-oncology trials and may help guide strategies aimed at promoting beneficial TLS states. Future work should incorporate longitudinal sampling under therapy, improved subclass or isotype-resolved antibody profiling as platforms mature, and functional perturbation to test causal mechanisms and refine TLS-informed clinical decision-making. 

english.text: Tertiary lymphoid structures (TLSs) are critical regulators of antitumor immunity, yet their spatial organization, maturation, and clinical relevance remain incompletely defined across cancers. We analyzed spatial transcriptomics spanning 12 cancer types to construct a pan-cancer TLS atlas and characterized TLS spatial architecture and maturation states. TLS maturation was accompanied by coordinated remodeling of distinct niche cell populations and distance-dependent gradients in tumor programs, orthogonally supported by ultrahigh-plex single-cell spatial profiling. To enable scalable TLS profiling, we trained an artificial intelligence framework that predicts TLS maturation states directly from hematoxylin and eosin–stained images and evaluated it across TCGA and independent therapy cohorts. We further derived a maturation-aware composite score capturing intratumoral TLS state composition, which robustly stratifies patients across cancer and treatment contexts, outperforming conventional TLS metrics.

chinese.text: 三级淋巴结构（TLS）是抗肿瘤免疫的关键调节因子，但它们的空间组织、成熟度和临床相关性在癌症中仍未完全确定。我们分析了涵盖 12 种癌症类型的空间转录组学，构建了泛癌 TLS 图谱，并表征了 TLS 空间结构和成熟状态。 TLS 的成熟伴随着肿瘤程序中不同生态位细胞群和距离依赖性梯度的协调重塑，并由超高复数单细胞空间分析正交支持。为了实现可扩展的 TLS 分析，我们训练了一个人工智能框架，该框架直接从苏木精和伊红染色图像预测 TLS 成熟状态，并在 TCGA 和独立治疗队列中对其进行评估。我们进一步得出了一个成熟感知综合评分，捕获肿瘤内 TLS 状态组成，该评分对癌症和治疗背景下的患者进行了稳健的分层，优于传统的 TLS 指标。

source_fragments: Tertiary lymphoid structures (TLSs) are critical regulators of antitumor immunity, yet their spatial organization, maturation, and clinical relevance remain incompletely defined across cancers. We analyzed spatial transcriptomics spanning 12 cancer types to construct a pan-cancer TLS atlas and characterized TLS spatial architecture and maturation states. TLS maturation was accompanied by coordinated remodeling of distinct niche cell populations and distance-dependent gradients in tumor programs, orthogonally supported by ultrahigh-plex single-cell spatial profiling. To enable scalable TLS profiling, we trained an artificial intelligence framework that predicts TLS maturation states directly from hematoxylin and eosin–stained images and evaluated it across TCGA and independent therapy cohorts. We further derived a maturation-aware composite score capturing intratumoral TLS state composition, which robustly stratifies patients across cancer and treatment contexts, outperforming conventional TLS metrics.

english.text: Effective antitumor immunity in solid tumors depends on orchestrated local immune microenvironments that support lymphocyte activation. Tertiary lymphoid structures (TLSs) are ectopic lymphoid aggregates that arise in nonlymphoid tissues under chronic inflammatory conditions, including cancer (1). TLSs frequently develop within the tumor microenvironment (TME) and have been observed across a broad range of human solid tumors, where they contribute to lymphocyte activation, B cell immunity, and regulation of antitumor immune responses (2, 3). Intratumoral TLSs support B cell maturation and antibody production (3) and are associated with increased tumor-infiltrating lymphocytes, particularly effector memory CD8+ T cells (4). The presence of TLSs has been linked to favorable responses to immune checkpoint blockade (ICB) and prolonged survival across multiple cancer types

source_fragments: Effective antitumor immunity in solid tumors depends on orchestrated local immune microenvironments that support lymphocyte activation. Tertiary lymphoid structures (TLSs) are ectopic lymphoid aggregates that arise in nonlymphoid tissues under chronic inflammatory conditions, including cancer (1). TLSs frequently develop within the tumor microenvironment (TME) and have been observed across a broad range of human solid tumors, where they contribute to lymphocyte activation, B cell immunity, and regulation of antitumor immune responses (2, 3). Intratumoral TLSs support B cell maturation and antibody production (3) and are associated with increased tumor-infiltrating lymphocytes, particularly effector memory CD8+ T cells (4). The presence of TLSs has been linked to favorable responses to immune checkpoint blockade (ICB) and prolonged survival across multiple cancer types

english.text: (4–11), fueling interest in TLSs as predictive biomarkers, prognostic in dicators, and potential therapeutic targets (11–13).

chinese.text: (4-11)，激发了人们对 TLS 作为预测生物标志物、预测指标和潜在治疗靶点的兴趣 (11-13)。

source_fragments: (4–11), fueling interest in TLSs as predictive biomarkers, prognostic in dicators, and potential therapeutic targets (11–13).

english.text: Resembling secondary lymphoid organs, TLSs typically contain segregated B cell follicles and T cell zones, antigen-presenting cells, and specialized stromal components, including fibroblasts (14) and high endothelial venules (HEVs), which facilitate immune cell recruitment and spatial organization (3). Mature TLSs containing germinal centers (GCs) are generally associated with enhanced antitumor immunity and improved ICB efficacy (10, 15). However, accumulating evidence indicates that TLSs are highly heterogeneous in their spatial distribution, cellular composition, organization, and maturation state, both within and across anatomical sites and tumor types (16). TLSs can range from early lymphocyte aggregates to fully developed secondary follicle–like structures with GCs (16, 17), and their formation and maturation appear to be influenced by tumor antigenicity and local TME dynamics (2, 16). Tumor-intrinsic factors, including metabolic reprogramming, have also been implicated in constraining TLS maturation in specific cancer contexts (18).

chinese.text: TLS 与次级淋巴器官类似，通常包含分离的 B 细胞滤泡和 T 细胞区、抗原呈递细胞和特殊基质成分，包括成纤维细胞 (14) 和高内皮微静脉 (HEV)，促进免疫细胞募集和空间组织 (3)。含有生发中心 (GC) 的成熟 TLS 通常与增强的抗肿瘤免疫力和改善的 ICB 功效相关 (10, 15)。然而，越来越多的证据表明，TLS 在解剖部位和肿瘤类型内部和之间的空间分布、细胞组成、组织和成熟状态方面具有高度异质性 (16)。 TLS 的范围可以从早期淋巴细胞聚集体到具有 GC 的完全发育的次级卵泡样结构 (16, 17)，它们的形成和成熟似乎受到肿瘤抗原性和局部 TME 动态的影响 (2, 16)。肿瘤内在因素，包括代谢重编程，也与限制特定癌症背景下的 TLS 成熟有关 (18)。

However, accumulating evidence indicates that TLSs are highly heterogeneous in their spatial distribution, cellular composition, organization, and maturation state, both within and across anatomical sites and tumor types (16). TLSs can range from early lymphocyte aggregates to fully developed secondary follicle–like structures with GCs (16, 17), and their formation and maturation appear to be influenced by tumor antigenicity and local TME dynamics (2, 16). Tumor-intrinsic factors, including metabolic reprogramming, have also been implicated in constraining TLS maturation in specific cancer contexts (18).

english.text: Despite these advances, a systematic characterization of TLS phenotypic and functional heterogeneity in large tissue sections across cancer types remains lacking. Moreover, how TLS profiles relate to tumor molecular features and clinical outcomes across large cohorts and treatment contexts remains incompletely defined. Addressing these gaps is essential for understanding context-dependent mechanisms of TLS formation and function, laying a foundation for TLS-based biomarker development and informing therapeutic strategies aimed at modulating TLSs. Spatial profiling technologies provide new opportunities to study TLSs. For example, spatial transcriptomics (ST) now enables transcriptome-wide profiling across entire tissue sections, typ ically paired with high-resolution hematoxylin and eosin (H&E) images (19, 20), allowing detailed examination of TLSs within large tissue samples. However, scalable, integrated computational frameworks for automated TLS detection and phenotyping from spatial omics and histology data are currently lacking. Additionally, current approaches for TLS-based patient stratification are suboptimal. Most studies categorize patients based on the presence or absence of TLSs (21–23) or use broad groupings, such as mature versus immature TLSs (21, 24), which may not be sufficiently robust because they do not capture intratumoral heterogeneity in TLS states. There is a need to establish robust, scalable metrics to enable more precise patient stratification across diverse clinical settings and enhance the utility and impact of TLS-based biomarkers.

chinese.text: 尽管取得了这些进展，但仍然缺乏对跨癌症类型的大组织切片中 TLS 表型和功能异质性的系统表征。此外，TLS 概况如何与大型队列和治疗环境中的肿瘤分子特征和临床结果相关仍然不完全确定。解决这些差距对于理解 TLS 形成和功能的上下文相关机制至关重要，为基于 TLS 的生物标志物开发奠定基础，并为旨在调节 TLS 的治疗策略提供信息。空间剖析技术为研究 TLS 提供了新的机会。例如，空间转录组学 (ST) 现在可以对整个组织切片进行全转录组分析，通常与高分辨率苏木精和伊红 (H&E) 图像配对 (19, 20)，从而可以对大型组织样本中的 TLS 进行详细检查。然而，目前缺乏用于自动 TLS 检测和空间组学和组织学数据表型分析的可扩展、集成计算框架。此外，当前基于 TLS 的患者分层方法并不理想。大多数研究根据 TLS 的存在或不存在对患者进行分类 (21-23) 或使用广泛的分组，例如成熟与不成熟的 TLS (21, 24)，这可能不够稳健，因为它们没有捕获 TLS 状态下的肿瘤内异质性。需要建立稳健、可扩展的指标，以便在不同的临床环境中实现更精确的患者分层，并增强基于 TLS 的生物标志物的实用性和影响。

english.text: In this study, we developed a robust computational framework to automatically identify, segment, and phenotype TLSs across cancer types and applied it to a pan-cancer analysis. By integrating transcriptomic, spatial, histopathological, and clinical data, we systematically characterized TLS abundance, spatial distribution, size, maturation states, and transcriptomic programs in 340 ST samples across 12 cancer types and examined their interactions with tumor cells and the surrounding TME. Building on insights from paired spatial omics and histology, we trained a deep learning model to classify TLSs using H&E-stained whole-slide images (WSIs) alone and applied it to classify 25,088 TLSs from 3071 WSIs across 10 independent cohorts. Lastly, we developed a data-driven, unsupervised TLS-based patient stratification framework that outperformed existing approaches in prognostic evaluation. Together, this work provides a comprehensive landscape of TLS heterogeneity across cancers and establishes spatially defined TLS features and artificial intelligence (AI)–driven TLS classification as scalable tools for precision immuno-oncology.

chinese.text: 在这项研究中，我们开发了一个强大的计算框架来自动识别、分割和表型跨癌症类型的 TLS，并将其应用于泛癌分析。通过整合转录组学、空间、组织病理学和临床数据，我们系统地表征了 12 种癌症类型的 340 个 ST 样本中的 TLS 丰度、空间分布、大小、成熟状态和转录组程序，并检查了它们与肿瘤细胞和周围 TME 的相互作用。基于配对空间组学和组织学的见解，我们训练了一个深度学习模型，仅使用 H&E 染色的全切片图像 (WSI) 对 TLS 进行分类，并应用它对 10 个独立队列中 3071 个 WSI 中的 25,088 个 TLS 进行分类。最后，我们开发了一个数据驱动、无监督的基于 TLS 的患者分层框架，该框架在预后评估方面优于现有方法。总之，这项工作提供了跨癌症的 TLS 异质性的全面概况，并建立了空间定义的 TLS 特征和人工智能 (AI) 驱动的 TLS 分类作为精准免疫肿瘤学的可扩展工具。

Lastly, we developed a data-driven, unsupervised TLS-based patient stratification framework that outperformed existing approaches in prognostic evaluation. Together, this work provides a comprehensive landscape of TLS heterogeneity across cancers and establishes spatially defined TLS features and artificial intelligence (AI)–driven TLS classification as scalable tools for precision immuno-oncology.

chinese.text: 为了系统地表征癌症中 TLS 的空间和分子异质性，我们分析了从 12 种癌症类型的 255 名患者收集的 340 个肿瘤样本的 ST 数据，结合了公开数据集和内部数据集（图 1A 和表 S1 和 S2）。所有数据集均使用我们建立的计算框架进行统一处理（图1B；参见材料和方法）。 TLS 富集区域是根据源自策划的 TLS 基因集 (25)（表 S3）的高 TLS 签名分数来识别的，然后进行无监督的聚类、分割和过滤。每个分段的 TLS 都会自动分配一个唯一的标识符，产生 695 个 TLS 用于下游分析，包括成熟状态、空间位置和转录组分析的评估（图 1B）。

source_fragments: To systematically characterize the spatial and molecular heterogeneity of TLSs in cancer, we analyzed ST data from 340 tumor samples collected from 255 patients across 12 cancer types, incorporating both publicly available and in-house datasets (Fig. 1A and tables S1 and S2). All datasets were processed uniformly using our established computational framework (Fig. 1B; see materials and methods). TLS-enriched regions were identified based on high TLS signature scores derived from a curated TLS gene set (25) (table S3), followed by unsupervised clustering, segmentation, and filtering. Each segmented TLS was automatically assigned a unique identifier, yielding 695 TLSs for downstream analyses, including assessment of maturation state, spatial location, and transcriptomic profiling (Fig. 1B).

english.text: The proportion of samples containing TLSs varied substantially across cancer types (
Fig. 1C

). TLSs were most prevalent in lung adenocarcinoma (LUAD), kidney renal clear cell carcinoma (KIRC), stomach adenocarcinoma (STAD), breast cancer (BRCA), liver hepatocellular carcinoma (LIHC), and bladder carcinoma (BLCA), whereas pancreatic adenocarcinoma (PAAD), oral squamous cell carcinoma (OSCC), ovarian carcinoma (OVCA), and glioblastoma multiforme (GBM) exhibited few or no detectable TLSs. TLS size and frequency within individual tumors also differed markedly across cancer types (
Fig. 1D
and
table S4

). LUAD samples exhibited the highest number of TLSs per sample, whereas no TLSs were detected in the 36 GBM samples analyzed, despite prior evidence that TLSs can form in gliomas (26). The absence may reflect limited ST dataset availability and sampling depth for GBM.

TLSs were most prevalent in lung adenocarcinoma (LUAD), kidney renal clear cell carcinoma (KIRC), stomach adenocarcinoma (STAD), breast cancer (BRCA), liver hepatocellular carcinoma (LIHC), and bladder carcinoma (BLCA), whereas pancreatic adenocarcinoma (PAAD), oral squamous cell carcinoma (OSCC), ovarian carcinoma (OVCA), and glioblastoma multiforme (GBM) exhibited few or no detectable TLSs. english.text: We further classified TLSs into three spatial categories—intratumoral (IT), peritumoral (PT), and distal-tumoral (DT)—based on their spatial proximity to tumor regions (see materials and methods). TLSs were distributed relatively evenly across the three categories, with 214 IT, 231 PT, and 250 DT TLSs identified, although their relative proportions varied by cancer type (
Fig. 1E
and
table S4

). LUAD and CSCC showed higher fractions of IT TLSs, whereas BRCA was enriched for PT TLSs, and LIHC, colorectal cancer (CRC), BLCA, KIRC, and PAAD exhibited higher fractions of DT TLSs. Together, these analyses reveal pronounced heterogeneity in TLS prevalence, size, and spatial organization across cancers, underscoring the diverse architectural patterns of TLSs within the TME.

sections.title_en: TLS maturation states differ across cancer types
sections.title_zh: 不同癌种的TLS成熟状态存在差异

english.text: To characterize TLS maturation, we classified TLSs into three maturation states—early TLS (E-TLS), primary follicle–like TLS (P-TLS), and secondary follicle–like TLS (S-TLS)—using unsupervised clustering based on canonical markers of follicular dendritic cells (FDCs) and germinal center (GC) B cells (
Fig. 2A
and
table S4

; see materials and methods), consistent with established models of TLS development (1, 16). This analysis identified 379 E-TLSs (54.5%), 215 P-TLSs (31%), and 101 S-TLSs (14.5%). E-TLSs represent early lymphoid aggregates lacking organized follicular structure, P-TLSs exhibit segregated B- and T-cell zones with FDC presence but without a fully developed GC, and S-TLSs are characterized by well-organized B- and T-cell zones with established FDC networks and a localized GC (
Fig. 2B
and
fig. S1

). Con sistent with progressive maturation, TLS signature scores increased stepwise from E-TLS to S-TLS, accompanied by elevated expression of markers for T cells, B cells, FDCs (e.g., CR2, FCER2) and GC B cells (GCBs; e.g., BCL6, MKI67) (
Fig. 2C
). To validate these assignments, we generated paired ST (Visium, 10x Genomics) and spatial proteomics (SP, Lunaphore COMET or Akoya IO60) on the same or adjacent tissue sections (
table S5
; see materials and methods). ST-defined TLS architecture closely concorded with protein-level staining of key immune and stromal components (
Fig. 2D
and
fig. S2
), including B cell follicles, T-cell zones, FDC networks (
fig. S2A
), and GC features as well as additional TLS components, such as T follicular helper (Tfh) cells and fibroblasts (
fig. S2B
). Notably, in P-TLSs and S-TLSs, we consistently observed a CD21+ reticular or mesh-like pattern localized to the B cell follicular region, characteristic of FDC networks (
Fig. 2D
and
fig. S2A

). These features were reproducibly detected across spatial omics platforms and independently reviewed by board-certified pathologists, providing orthogonal histologic support for the robustness and biological validity of our TLS maturation assignments.

chinese.text: 为了表征 TLS 成熟，我们使用基于滤泡树突细胞 (FDC) 和生发中心 (GC) B 细胞的典型标记的无监督聚类，将 TLS 分为三种成熟状态：早期 TLS (E-TLS)、初级卵泡样 TLS (P-TLS) 和次级卵泡样 TLS (S-TLS)（图 2A 和表 S4；参见材料和方法），与已建立的 TLS 模型一致发展 (1, 16)。该分析确定了 379 个 E-TLS (54.5%)、215 个 P-TLS (31%) 和 101 个 S-TLS (14.5%)。 E-TLS代表缺乏有组织的滤泡结构的早期淋巴聚集体，P-TLS表现出分离的B细胞和T细胞区域，存在FDC，但没有完全发育的GC，而S-TLS的特点是组织良好的B细胞和T细胞区域，具有已建立的FDC网络和局部GC（图2B和图S1）。与逐渐成熟一致，TLS 特征评分从 E-TLS 逐步增加到 S-TLS，伴随着 T 细胞、B 细胞、FDC（例如 CR2、FCER2）和 GC B 细胞（GCB；例如 BCL6、MKI67）标记物表达的升高（图 2C）。为了验证这些分配，我们在相同或相邻的组织切片上生成了配对 ST（Visium、10x Genomics）和空间蛋白质组学（SP、Lunaphore COMET 或 Akoya IO60）（表 S5；参见材料和方法）。 ST定义的TLS架构与关键免疫和基质成分的蛋白质水平染色密切一致（图2D和图S2），包括B细胞滤泡、T细胞区域、FDC网络（图S2A）和GC特征以及其他TLS成分，例如滤泡辅助T（Tfh）细胞和成纤维细胞（图S2B）。值得注意的是，在 P-TLS 和 S-TLS 中，我们一致观察到位于 B 细胞滤泡区域的 CD21+ 网状或网状图案，这是 FDC 网络的特征（图 2D 和图 S2A）。这些特征在空间组学平台上可重复检测，并由委员会认证的病理学家独立审查，为我们的 TLS 成熟分配的稳健性和生物学有效性提供正交组织学支持。

english.text: We next examined the spatial distribution of TLS maturation states across IT, PT, and DT regions (
Fig. 2E
). P-TLSs were preferentially enriched in DT regions, whereas E-TLSs were more frequently observed within IT regions (
Fig. 2E
). TLS size increased progressively with maturation state, with S-TLSs significantly larger than P-TLSs and E-TLSs (
Fig. 2F
and
fig. S2C
). Analysis across cancer types revealed marked heterogeneity in TLS maturation states (
Fig. 2
, G and H). S-TLSs were enriched in STAD, P-TLSs were enriched in LIHC and CRC, and E-TLSs were enriched in BRCA and OVCA (
Fig. 2H

). Inte grating maturation state with spatial location further delineated nine TLS subtypes, revealing additional layers of heterogeneity across tumor types. For example, DT P-TLSs predominated in LIHC, CRC, and BLCA; PT E-TLSs predominated in OVCA, BRCA, and LUAD; and DT E-TLSs predominated in PAAD and KIRC (
Fig. 2I
). Together, these results demonstrate that TLS maturation and spatial organization vary substantially across cancers, highlighting the context-dependent nature of TLS development.

chinese.text: 接下来我们检查了 TLS 成熟状态在 IT、PT 和 DT 区域的空间分布（图 2E）。 P-TLS优先富集在DT区域，而E-TLS在IT区域更常见（图2E）。 TLS 大小随着成熟状态逐渐增加，其中 S-TLS 显着大于 P-TLS 和 E-TLS（图 2F 和图 S2C）。跨癌症类型的分析揭示了 TLS 成熟状态的显着异质性（图 2、G 和 H）。 S-TLS在STAD中富集，P-TLS在LIHC和CRC中富集，E-TLS在BRCA和OVCA中富集（图2H）。将成熟状态与空间位置相结合进一步描述了九种 TLS 亚型，揭示了肿瘤类型之间额外的异质性层。例如，DT P-TLS 在 LIHC、CRC 和 BLCA 中占主导地位； PT E-TLS 在 OVCA、BRCA 和 LUAD 中占主导地位；和 DT E-TLS 在 PAAD 和 KIRC 中占主导地位（图 2I）。总之，这些结果表明，不同癌症的 TLS 成熟度和空间组织差异很大，突出了 TLS 发展的环境依赖性。

source_fragments: We next examined the spatial distribution of TLS maturation states across IT, PT, and DT regions (Fig. 2E). P-TLSs were preferentially enriched in DT regions, whereas E-TLSs were more frequently observed within IT regions (Fig. 2E). TLS size increased progressively with maturation state, with S-TLSs significantly larger than P-TLSs and E-TLSs (Fig. 2F and fig. S2C). Analysis across cancer types revealed marked heterogeneity in TLS maturation states (Fig. 2, G and H). S-TLSs were enriched in STAD, P-TLSs were enriched in LIHC and CRC, and E-TLSs were enriched in BRCA and OVCA (Fig. 2H). Inte grating maturation state with spatial location further delineated nine TLS subtypes, revealing additional layers of heterogeneity across tumor types. For example, DT P-TLSs predominated in LIHC, CRC, and BLCA; PT E-TLSs predominated in OVCA, BRCA, and LUAD; and DT E-TLSs predominated in PAAD and KIRC (Fig. 2I). Together, these results demonstrate that TLS maturation and spatial organization vary substantially across cancers, highlighting the context-dependent nature of TLS development.

Fig. 3A
and
fig. S3

As TLSs progressed from E-TLSs to S-TLSs, we observed increased expression of DC-associated markers (e.g., CD1C, CD86, LAMP3), DCrecruitment cues (CCL19, CCL21, CCR7), and cytokines (IL12A, IL27) together with enrichment of macrophage activation programs and macrophage-attracting chemokines (CCL2, CCL4, CXCL16) and cytokines (IL10, IL6) and along with stronger antigen-presentation signals (

sections.title_en: TLS proximity associates with spatial gradients of tumor signaling
sections.title_zh: TLS距离与肿瘤信号空间梯度相关

english.text: To investigate spatial associations between tumor programs and TLS characteristics, we correlated tumor-pathway activity in tumorenriched spots with sample-level TLS features, including E-, P-, and S-TLS proportions and TLS location metrics, as well as locationstratified maturation measures (see materials and methods). These analyses were designed to characterize spatial associations between TLS features and tumor signaling rather than infer causal effects of TLSs on tumor programs. Across cancers, TLS maturation state and spatial location were associated with distinct tumor pathway profiles (
fig. S4A

). E-TLSs generally showed positive correlations with proliferative and inflammatory pathways and negative correlations with metabolic and stress-adaptive programs in tumor spots. By contrast, more mature TLSs, particularly PT P-TLSs and S-TLSs, exhibited attenuated associations with proliferative and inflammatory tumor programs relative to E-TLSs and instead showed positive associations with immune-related pathways, including complement activation and interferon (IFN)–γ and IFN-α responses. In addition, IT S-TLSs showed negative associations with tumor-related programs, such as proliferation, epithelialmesenchymal transition (EMT), angiogenesis, and MYC signaling. P-TLSs displayed location-dependent patterns, with PT P-TLSs more closely resembling S-TLS-associated profiles. Together, these results indicate that TLS maturation and spatial context are linked to distinct tumor signaling environments, highlighting maturation- and locationdependent heterogeneity in TLS-associated tumor-microenvironment interactions.

chinese.text: 为了研究肿瘤程序和 TLS 特征之间的空间关联，我们将肿瘤富集点的肿瘤通路活性与样本级 TLS 特征相关联，包括 E-、P-和 S-TLS 比例和 TLS 位置指标，以及位置分层成熟测量（参见材料和方法）。这些分析旨在表征 TLS 特征与肿瘤信号传导之间的空间关联，而不是推断 TLS 对肿瘤程序的因果影响。在所有癌症中，TLS 成熟状态和空间位置与不同的肿瘤通路谱相关（图 S4A）。 E-TLS 通常与肿瘤点的增殖和炎症途径呈正相关，与代谢和应激适应性程序呈负相关。相比之下，更成熟的 TLS，特别是 PT P-TLS 和 S-TLS，与 E-TLS 相比，与增殖性和炎症性肿瘤程序的关联减弱，而是与免疫相关途径呈正相关，包括补体激活和干扰素 (IFN)-γ 和 IFN-α 反应。此外，IT S-TLS 与肿瘤相关程序呈负相关，例如增殖、上皮间质转化 (EMT)、血管生成和 MYC 信号传导。 P-TLS 显示位置相关模式，PT P-TLS 更类似于 S-TLS 相关配置文件。总之，这些结果表明 TLS 成熟和空间背景与不同的肿瘤信号传导环境相关，突出了 TLS 相关肿瘤微环境相互作用中成熟和位置依赖性异质性。

These analyses were designed to characterize spatial associations between TLS features and tumor signaling rather than infer causal effects of TLSs on tumor programs. Across cancers, TLS maturation state and spatial location were associated with distinct tumor pathway profiles (fig. S4A). E-TLSs generally showed positive correlations with proliferative and inflammatory pathways and negative correlations with metabolic and stress-adaptive programs in tumor spots. By contrast, more mature TLSs, particularly PT P-TLSs and S-TLSs, exhibited attenuated associations with proliferative and inflammatory tumor programs relative to E-TLSs and instead showed positive associations with immune-related pathways, including complement activation and interferon (IFN)–γ and IFN-α responses. In addition, IT S-TLSs showed negative associations with tumor-related programs, such as proliferation, epithelialmesenchymal transition (EMT), angiogenesis, and MYC signaling. P-TLSs displayed location-dependent patterns, with PT P-TLSs more closely resembling S-TLS-associated profiles. Together, these results indicate that TLS maturation and spatial context are linked to distinct tumor signaling environments, highlighting maturation- and locationdependent heterogeneity in TLS-associated tumor-microenvironment interactions.

english.text: We then examined how TLS proximity shapes tumor signaling by modeling pathway activity as a function of spatial distance from IT TLSs (
Fig. 4A
). Two dominant spatial gradients emerged across cancers (
Fig. 4

, B to D). Immune-related pathways, including IFN-α and IFN-γ responses, major histocompatibility complex class II antigen presentation, and inflammatory signaling, were highest in tumor regions proximal to TLSs and progressively decreased with distance (“high-to-low” gradients). By contrast, tumor-intrinsic programs associated with proliferation and invasion, such as MYC signaling, G2/M checkpoint, EMT, and KRAS signaling, were lowest near TLSs and increased with distance (“low-to-high” gradients) (
Fig. 4C
). These spatial patterns were conserved across multiple cancer types (
Fig. 4

, C and D). When applying the same distance-based framework to TLSs located in histologically normal tissues, immune-related pathways retained similar proximity-dependent gradients, whereas tumor-intrinsic proliferative and invasive gradients were absent (
fig. S4B

). This contrast indicates that TLS-associated immune activation represents a conserved spatial feature of TLS niches, whereas distance-dependent tumorassociated pathway gradients are specific to malignant tissue contexts.

chinese.text: 然后，我们通过将通路活动建模为与 IT TLS 的空间距离的函数，研究了 TLS 邻近性如何影响肿瘤信号传导（图 4A）。癌症中出现了两个主要的空间梯度（图 4，B 到 D）。免疫相关途径，包括 IFN-α 和 IFN-γ 反应、主要组织相容性复合物 II 类抗原呈递和炎症信号传导，在靠近 TLS 的肿瘤区域中最高，并随着距离的增加逐渐降低（“从高到低”梯度）。相比之下，与增殖和侵袭相关的肿瘤内在程序，如 MYC 信号、G2/M 检查点、EMT 和 KRAS 信号，在 TLS 附近最低，并随着距离的增加而增加（“从低到高”梯度）（图 4C）。这些空间模式在多种癌症类型中都是保守的（图 4、C 和 D）。当将相同的基于距离的框架应用于位于组织学正常组织中的 TLS 时，免疫相关通路保留了类似的邻近依赖性梯度，而肿瘤固有的增殖和侵袭梯度不存在（图 S4B）。这种对比表明，TLS 相关的免疫激活代表了 TLS 生态位的保守空间特征，而距离依赖性肿瘤相关通路梯度则特定于恶性组织环境。

source_fragments: We then examined how TLS proximity shapes tumor signaling by modeling pathway activity as a function of spatial distance from IT TLSs (Fig. 4A). Two dominant spatial gradients emerged across cancers (Fig. 4, B to D). Immune-related pathways, including IFN-α and IFN-γ responses, major histocompatibility complex class II antigen presentation, and inflammatory signaling, were highest in tumor regions proximal to TLSs and progressively decreased with distance (“high-to-low” gradients). By contrast, tumor-intrinsic programs associated with proliferation and invasion, such as MYC signaling, G2/M checkpoint, EMT, and KRAS signaling, were lowest near TLSs and increased with distance (“low-to-high” gradients) (Fig. 4C). These spatial patterns were conserved across multiple cancer types (Fig. 4, C and D). When applying the same distance-based framework to TLSs located in histologically normal tissues, immune-related pathways retained similar proximity-dependent gradients, whereas tumor-intrinsic proliferative and invasive gradients were absent (fig. S4B). This contrast indicates that TLS-associated immune activation represents a conserved spatial feature of TLS niches, whereas distance-dependent tumorassociated pathway gradients are specific to malignant tissue contexts.

english.text: To explore potential signaling interactions at the TLS-tumor interface, we analyzed ligand-receptor pairs enriched within IT TLSs’ boundaries by comparing gene expression within IT TLS cores to their immediate 50-μm margins (see materials and methods;
fig. S4C

). Several immune signaling genes, including TNFSF14, CXCR3, and CXCR6, were preferentially expressed within TLS cores, whereas their cognate receptor or ligands (TNFRSF14, CXCL10/11, and CXCL16) exhibited pronounced distance-dependent “high-to-low” gradients in surrounding tumor regions, peaking at TLS-proximal tumor spots and progressively decreasing with increasing distance across multiple cancer types (
Fig. 4E
). These patterns are consistent with the presence of shortrange cytokine and chemokine signaling fields associated with TLSs.

chinese.text: 为了探索 TLS-肿瘤界面上潜在的信号相互作用，我们通过将 IT TLS 核心内的基因表达与其直接 50 μm 边缘进行比较，分析了 IT TLS 边界内富集的配体-受体对（参见材料和方法；图 S4C）。包括TNFSF14、CXCR3和CXCR6在内的几种免疫信号基因优先在TLS核心内表达，而它们的同源受体或配体（TNFRSF14、CXCL10/11和CXCL16）在周围肿瘤区域表现出明显的距离依赖性“从高到低”梯度，在TLS近端肿瘤点达到峰值，并随着多种癌症类型距离的增加而逐渐下降（图4E）。这些模式与 TLS 相关的短程细胞因子和趋化因子信号传导场的存在一致。

S4C). These patterns are consistent with the presence of shortrange cytokine and chemokine signaling fields associated with TLSs.

english.text: We further validated these spatial relationships at single-cell resolution using paired Visium and Xenium Prime 5K datasets from our in-house LUAD cohort (
Fig. 4F
and
fig. S4D

; see materials and methods) (37). TLS cores were enriched for TNFSF14, CXCR3, and CXCR6 transcripts, whereas TNFRSF14, CXCL10/11, and CXCL16 localized predominantly to tumor or stromal cells immediately adjacent to TLSs (
Fig. 4G

). This complementary spatial organization, mapped at single-cell and subcellular resolution, supports localized inflammatory signaling patterns centered on TLSs and engagement of cognate signaling partners within TLS-proximal tumor regions. chinese.text: 我们使用来自我们内部 LUAD 队列的配对 Visium 和 Xenium Prime 5K 数据集进一步验证了单细胞分辨率下的这些空间关系（图 4F 和图 S4D；参见材料和方法）(37)。 TLS核心富含TNFSF14、CXCR3和CXCR6转录本，而TNFRSF14、CXCL10/11和CXCL16主要定位于紧邻TLS的肿瘤或基质细胞（图4G）。这种互补的空间组织以单细胞和亚细胞分辨率绘制，支持以 TLS 为中心的局部炎症信号传导模式以及 TLS 近端肿瘤区域内同源信号传导伙伴的参与。总之，这些结果表明 TLS 嵌入短程细胞因子和趋化因子信号传导场中，其特征是 TLS 肿瘤界面处的免疫、肿瘤和基质区室中配体和受体的空间协调表达。

S4D; see materials and methods) (37). english.text: Overall, across cohorts, we observed consistent but not statistically powered trends linking TLS maturation states with tumor pathological grade, genomic context, and chronic inflammatory etiologies. sections.title_en: Scalable AI framework for TLS detection and maturation classification from H&E images
sections.title_zh: 从H&E检测TLS并分类成熟状态的可扩展AI框架

english.text: Given the limited size of available ST cohorts, we developed an AIenabled framework for automatic TLS detection and maturation classification using H&E-stained WSIs alone. We curated a total of 3071 WSIs from 10 cohorts, including 6 TCGA cohorts [lung squamous cell carcinoma (LUSC, n = 374), BLCA (n = 345), KIRC (n = 299), LUAD (n = 540), STAD (n = 442), and COAD (n = 458)] and 4 independent therapy cohorts [ovarian clear cell carcinoma (OCCC, n = 39) (43), high-grade serous ovarian carcinoma (HGSOC, n = 286) (44), and BRCA (n = 203, n = 85) (45, 46)] (
Fig. 6A
, left). To achieve this, we first applied HookNet-TLS (47) to detect TLSs in WSIs, followed by segmentation and TLS image extraction, yielding a total of 25,088 labeled TLSs across the 10 cohorts (
Fig. 6A

, middle). We then leveraged YOLOv8 (48), an advanced con volutional neural network for object detection and classification, to train a two-step classifier that first distinguishes E-TLSs from mature TLSs (mTLSs), followed by subclassification of mTLSs into P-TLSs and S-TLSs (
Fig. 6A
, right).

chinese.text: 鉴于可用 ST 队列的规模有限，我们开发了一个 AI 框架，仅使用 H&E 染色的 WSI 进行自动 TLS 检测和成熟分类。我们从 10 个队列中总共筛选了 3071 个 WSI，其中包括 6 个 TCGA 队列 [肺鳞状细胞癌 (LUSC，n = 374)、BLCA (n = 345)、KIRC (n = 299)、LUAD (n = 540)、STAD (n = 442) 和 COAD (n = 458)] 和 4 个独立治疗队列[卵巢透明细胞癌 (OCCC, n = 39) (43)、高级别浆液性卵巢癌 (HGSOC, n = 286) (44) 和 BRCA (n = 203, n = 85) (45, 46)]（图 6A，左）。为了实现这一目标，我们首先应用 HookNet-TLS (47) 来检测 WSI 中的 TLS，然后进行分割和 TLS 图像提取，在 10 个队列中生成总共 25,088 个标记的 TLS（图 6A，中）。然后，我们利用 YOLOv8 (48)（一种用于对象检测和分类的高级卷积神经网络）来训练一个两步分类器，该分类器首先区分 E-TLS 和成熟的 TLS (mTLS)，然后将 mTLS 子分类为 P-TLS 和 S-TLS（图 6A，右）。

source_fragments: Given the limited size of available ST cohorts, we developed an AIenabled framework for automatic TLS detection and maturation classification using H&E-stained WSIs alone. We curated a total of 3071 WSIs from 10 cohorts, including 6 TCGA cohorts [lung squamous cell carcinoma (LUSC, n = 374), BLCA (n = 345), KIRC (n = 299), LUAD (n = 540), STAD (n = 442), and COAD (n = 458)] and 4 independent therapy cohorts [ovarian clear cell carcinoma (OCCC, n = 39) (43), high-grade serous ovarian carcinoma (HGSOC, n = 286) (44), and BRCA (n = 203, n = 85) (45, 46)] (Fig. 6A, left). To achieve this, we first applied HookNet-TLS (47) to detect TLSs in WSIs, followed by segmentation and TLS image extraction, yielding a total of 25,088 labeled TLSs across the 10 cohorts (Fig. 6A, middle). We then leveraged YOLOv8 (48), an advanced con volutional neural network for object detection and classification, to train a two-step classifier that first distinguishes E-TLSs from mature TLSs (mTLSs), followed by subclassification of mTLSs into P-TLSs and S-TLSs (Fig. 6A, right).

english.text: Training data were derived from three TCGA cohorts (LUSC, BLCA, KIRC), comprising 956 TLS images automatically segmented from H&E WSIs. TLS images were split into 80% training and 20% held-out test sets, stratified by cancer type, with manual annotations from experienced pathologists used as ground truth (
fig. S5A

; see materials and methods). To mitigate batch effects arising from variability in staining, scanning, and tissue preparation, YOLOv8 was trained with extensive data augmentation (e.g., flips, rotations, scaling, cutout, mix-up, brightness and contrast shifts, hue and saturation jitter, and Gaussian blur and noise). This augmentation strategy was designed to improve robustness to intersite and interplatform variability, enabling reliable TLS classification across heterogeneous histopathology datasets. The classifiers demonstrated robust performance across cancer types, with E-TLS versus mTLS and P-TLS versus S-TLS classification accuracies of 95.1 and 85.0% in BLCA, 90.0 and 95.6% in LUSC, and 84.0 and 89.5% in KIRC, respectively (figs. S5, B to E).

chinese.text: 训练数据来自三个 TCGA 队列（LUSC、BLCA、KIRC），包括从 H&E WSI 自动分割的 956 张 TLS 图像。 TLS 图像被分为 80% 的训练集和 20% 的保留测试集，按癌症类型分层，并使用经验丰富的病理学家的手动注释作为基本事实（图 S5A；参见材料和方法）。为了减轻因染色、扫描和组织制备的变化而产生的批次效应，YOLOv8 通过大量数据增强进行训练（例如翻转、旋转、缩放、剪切、混合、亮度和对比度偏移、色调和饱和度抖动以及高斯模糊和噪声）。这种增强策略旨在提高对站点间和平台间变异性的鲁棒性，从而实现跨异构组织病理学数据集的可靠 TLS 分类。该分类器在各种癌症类型中表现出强大的性能，其中 E-TLS 与 mTLS 以及 P-TLS 与 S-TLS 的分类准确率在 BLCA 中分别为 95.1 和 85.0%，在 LUSC 中分别为 90.0 和 95.6%，在 KIRC 中分别为 84.0 和 89.5%（图 S5、B 至 E）。

source_fragments: Training data were derived from three TCGA cohorts (LUSC, BLCA, KIRC), comprising 956 TLS images automatically segmented from H&E WSIs. TLS images were split into 80% training and 20% held-out test sets, stratified by cancer type, with manual annotations from experienced pathologists used as ground truth (fig. S5A; see materials and methods). To mitigate batch effects arising from variability in staining, scanning, and tissue preparation, YOLOv8 was trained with extensive data augmentation (e.g., flips, rotations, scaling, cutout, mix-up, brightness and contrast shifts, hue and saturation jitter, and Gaussian blur and noise). This augmentation strategy was designed to improve robustness to intersite and interplatform variability, enabling reliable TLS classification across heterogeneous histopathology datasets. The classifiers demonstrated robust performance across cancer types, with E-TLS versus mTLS and P-TLS versus S-TLS classification accuracies of 95.1 and 85.0% in BLCA, 90.0 and 95.6% in LUSC, and 84.0 and 89.5% in KIRC, respectively (figs. S5, B to E).

english.text: To assess cross-cancer generalizability, we applied the trained classifier directly to the 695 segmented TLS images extracted from H&E WSIs in our spatial discovery cohorts (
Fig. 1A
), using TLS maturation states derived from matched ST data as the reference standard (
Fig. 1B
). The model recapitulated the overall TLS-state distribution (
fig. S6A
) and achieved high accuracy for both the E-TLS versus mTLS step and the P-TLS versus S-TLS subclassification step (
fig. S6

, B and C). Spe cifically, the model correctly identified 92.3% of E-TLSs and 90.2% of mTLSs [overall accuracy 91.4%; 95% confidence interval (CI) 89.0–93.3; receiver operating characteristic area under the curve (ROC AUC) 0.908;
fig. S6B
]. For subclassification of mTLSs, the model correctly identified 98.0% of P-TLSs and 87.5% of S-TLSs (
fig. S6C

), with an overall accuracy of 94.7% (95% CI 91.4–97.0) and an ROC AUC of 0.928, despite class imbalance. Notably, this performance was achieved in multicancer ST cohorts not represented during training, without any retraining or parameter adjustment. Together, these results demonstrate that the YOLOv8-based classifier generalizes robustly across cancer types and tissue contexts.

chinese.text: 为了评估跨癌症的普遍性，我们将经过训练的分类器直接应用于从空间发现队列中的 H&E WSI 中提取的 695 个分段 TLS 图像（图 1A），并使用从匹配的 ST 数据导出的 TLS 成熟状态作为参考标准（图 1B）。该模型概括了整体 TLS 状态分布（图 S6A），并在 E-TLS 与 mTLS 步骤以及 P-TLS 与 S-TLS 子分类步骤（图 S6、B 和 C）方面实现了高精度。具体来说，该模型正确识别了 92.3% 的 E-TLS 和 90.2% 的 mTLS [总体准确率 91.4%； 95% 置信区间 (CI) 89.0–93.3；受试者工作特征曲线下面积（ROC AUC）0.908；如图。 S6B]。对于 mTLS 的子分类，该模型正确识别了 98.0% 的 P-TLS 和 87.5% 的 S-TLS（图 S6C），尽管类别不平衡，总体准确率为 94.7% (95% CI 91.4–97.0)，ROC AUC 为 0.928。值得注意的是，这种性能是在训练期间未代表的多癌症 ST 队列中实现的，无需任何再训练或参数调整。总之，这些结果表明基于 YOLOv8 的分类器在癌症类型和组织环境中具有稳健的泛化能力。

source_fragments: To assess cross-cancer generalizability, we applied the trained classifier directly to the 695 segmented TLS images extracted from H&E WSIs in our spatial discovery cohorts (Fig. 1A), using TLS maturation states derived from matched ST data as the reference standard (Fig. 1B). The model recapitulated the overall TLS-state distribution (fig. S6A) and achieved high accuracy for both the E-TLS versus mTLS step and the P-TLS versus S-TLS subclassification step (fig. S6, B and C). Spe cifically, the model correctly identified 92.3% of E-TLSs and 90.2% of mTLSs [overall accuracy 91.4%; 95% confidence interval (CI) 89.0–93.3; receiver operating characteristic area under the curve (ROC AUC) 0.908; fig. S6B]. For subclassification of mTLSs, the model correctly identified 98.0% of P-TLSs and 87.5% of S-TLSs (fig. S6C), with an overall accuracy of 94.7% (95% CI 91.4–97.0) and an ROC AUC of 0.928, despite class imbalance. Notably, this performance was achieved in multicancer ST cohorts not represented during training, without any retraining or parameter adjustment. Together, these results demonstrate that the YOLOv8-based classifier generalizes robustly across cancer types and tissue contexts.

english.text: Next, we applied the AI-enabled TLS detection and maturation framework to H&E WSIs from all 6 TCGA cohorts (
Fig. 6
, A and B) to evaluate whether the stage-associated TLS maturation trends observed in our spatial discovery cohorts (
Fig. 5

) were reproducible at scale. Across STAD, COAD [microsatellite instability low (MSI-L) and microsatellite stable (MSS)], and KIRC, we observed a stage-associated shift in TLS composition, with increased proportions of P-TLSs and S-TLSs in more advanced-stage tumors relative to those in early-disease (
Fig. 6C
). By contrast, LUSC, LUAD, BLCA, and COAD [microsatellite instability high (MSI-H)] did not exhibit a consistent pattern (
fig. S7A
). When cohorts were combined, TLS maturation-state distributions shifted significantly across stages I to III, whereas stage IV tumors showed substantial overlap and no further separation (
Fig. 6D
). Overall, TLS maturation frequently, but not uniformly, tracks with tumor stage, with the association most evident in early-to-intermediate stages.

english.text: We further assessed how TLS maturation states relate to established immune and genomic features defined in prior TCGA analyses (
fig. S7B

) (49). We observed a progressive increase from E-TLSs to P-TLSs and then to S-TLSs in their associations with tumor mutation burden (including single-nucleotide variant and indel neoantigens), homologous recombination deficiency, intratumoral heterogeneity, lymphocyte infiltration, leukocyte fraction, IFN-γ response, and wound-healing signals (
fig. S7B

). These patterns are consistent with a maturationassociated trajectory in which mature TLSs occur in tumors with more genomically altered and immune-active microenvironments. sections.title_en: TLS maturation-aware composite scoring enables robust patient stratification
sections.title_zh: 成熟度感知复合评分实现稳健患者分层

english.text: We next evaluated the prognostic performance of TLS maturation using commonly used patient classification strategies (21–24), including TLS presence versus absence (
Fig. 6E
, left, and
fig. S7C
), dominant TLS maturation state (
Fig. 6E
, middle, and
fig. S7D
), and broader groupings of immature (i.e., E-TLS) versus mature TLSs (
Fig. 6E
, right, and
fig. S7E

). Across six cancer types, these approaches failed to provide consistent prognostic separation. Binary classification based on TLS presence alone did not reliably stratify overall survival (OS) in Kaplan-Meier (KM) analyses, regardless of TLS maturation state. Similarly, classification by dominant TLS state using fine-grained or grouped categories did not yield robust survival differences across cohorts. Only KIRC showed a significant association with S-TLS dominance, underscoring the cancer-type specificity of TLS-outcome relationships rather than a universal rule (
Fig. 6E
and
fig. S7
, C to E). Together, these results highlight fundamental limitations of existing TLS-based stratification strategies.

source_fragments: We next evaluated the prognostic performance of TLS maturation using commonly used patient classification strategies (21–24), including TLS presence versus absence (Fig. 6E, left, and fig. S7C), dominant TLS maturation state (Fig. 6E, middle, and fig. S7D), and broader groupings of immature (i.e., E-TLS) versus mature TLSs (Fig. 6E, right, and fig. S7E). Across six cancer types, these approaches failed to provide consistent prognostic separation. Binary classification based on TLS presence alone did not reliably stratify overall survival (OS) in Kaplan-Meier (KM) analyses, regardless of TLS maturation state. Only KIRC showed a significant association with S-TLS dominance, underscoring the cancer-type specificity of TLS-outcome relationships rather than a universal rule (Fig. 6E and fig. S7, C to E). Together, these results highlight fundamental limitations of existing TLS-based stratification strategies.

english.text: Building on insights from spatial TLS profiling, we sought to develop a patient stratification framework that captures both TLS abundance and maturation state heterogeneity within a tumor rather than collapsing tumors into a single dominant state. To this end, we derived a data-driven composite TLS score using principal component analysis (PCA) on log-transformed, z-score–normalized counts of E-TLSs, P-TLSs, and S-TLSs (
Fig. 6F

; see materials and methods). This unsupervised approach captures the dominant axes of variation in TLS state composition across tumors, yielding a continuous score that reflects both TLS abundance and maturation state diversity within individual tumors. Applying a median-based threshold, we stratified TLS-positive tumors into two groups: C1 and C2 (
Fig. 6F
and
table S7
). Among TLS+ samples, the C1 group was enriched for P-TLSs and S-TLSs, whereas the C2 group was dominated by E-TLSs (
fig. S8A
and
table S8
), explicitly accounting for intratumoral TLS heterogeneity.

chinese.text: 为了检查 TLS 成熟是否与治疗反应相关，我们首先分析了接受 ICB 治疗的独立内部 OCCC 患者队列（图 6H）（43）。与先前将 OCCC 患者免疫治疗后 PPP2R1A 功能丧失突变与 OS 改善联系起来的观察结果一致，与 PPP2R1A WT 肿瘤相比，PPP2R1A 突变肿瘤表现出显着更高的 P-TLS 和 S-TLS 计数（图 6I，顶部）。治疗前的 TLS 成熟状态组成在短生存组和长生存组之间也存在显着差异，在长生存病例中成熟 TLS 状态丰富（图 6I，底部）。值得注意的是，这些差异在治疗时间点并不显着，这表明基线 TLS 综合评分可能比治疗变化更能说明治疗结果。尽管统计功效有限，但当按治疗反应对患者进行分层时，观察到了类似的方向趋势（图 S7F）。

source_fragments: To examine whether TLS maturation is associated with therapeutic response, we first analyzed an independent in-house cohort of OCCC patients treated with ICB (Fig. 6H) (43). Consistent with prior observations linking PPP2R1A loss-of-function mutations to improved OS following immunotherapy in OCCC patients, PPP2R1A-mutant tumors exhibited significantly higher counts of P-TLSs and S-TLSs compared with PPP2R1A WT tumors (Fig. 6I, top). TLS maturation state composition prior to treatment also differed significantly between short- and long-survival groups, with enrichment of mature TLS states in longsurvival cases (Fig. 6I, bottom). Notably, these differences were not significant at the on-treatment timepoint, suggesting that baseline TLS composite scores may be more informative of therapeutic outcome than on-treatment changes. Similar directional trends were observed when stratifying patients by treatment response, although statistical power was limited (fig. S7F).

english.text: Lastly, we evaluated whether associations between TLS maturation and therapeutic response extend to nonimmunotherapy treatment settings, including chemotherapy and targeted therapy, where treatment exposure is much more common clinically. Fig. 6J
) (44), neoadjuvant combination chemotherapy (breast cancer,
Fig. 6L

Fig. 6N

Fig. 6

, J to O). Despite differences in tumor type and treatment modality, these results were directionally concordant, supporting the general relevance of TLS maturation composition to therapeutic response across diverse clinical contexts.

source_fragments: TLSs represent specialized immune niches that can shape antitumor immunity across solid tumors (3, 40, 50–52). Yet their spatial organization, maturation states, relationships to tumor cells and the surrounding

english.text: TME, and clinical relevance have not been systematically characterized at scale across cancer types. In this study, we used ST data to build a pancancer atlas of TLSs across 12 cancer types, with ultrahigh-plex, singlecell-resolved spatial RNA and protein profiling providing orthogonal validation in selected cohorts and integrated these findings with histopathology and clinical data. By developing a scalable AI-enabled framework to detect and classify TLSs directly from routine H&E WSIs, we have extended TLS analysis from limited spatial datasets to thousands of tumors. Leveraging this scalability, we have introduced a TLS maturationaware composite scoring strategy that captures within-tumor TLS state composition and enables robust patient stratification across cancers and treatment contexts. Together, this work establishes generalizable and clinically scalable frameworks for TLS profiling and highlights TLS state composition as a key dimension of tumor immune organization with translational relevance. It also provides a foundation for prospective evaluation of TLS-informed biomarkers in clinical settings.

chinese.text: TME 和临床相关性尚未在不同癌症类型中进行大规模系统表征。在这项研究中，我们使用 ST 数据构建了涵盖 12 种癌症类型的 TLS 的全癌图谱，其中超高复数、单细胞解析的空间 RNA 和蛋白质分析在选定的队列中提供了正交验证，并将这些发现与组织病理学和临床数据相结合。通过开发一个可扩展的人工智能框架来直接从常规 H&E WSI 中检测和分类 TLS，我们已将 TLS 分析从有限的空间数据集扩展到数千个肿瘤。利用这种可扩展性，我们引入了 TLS 成熟感知复合评分策略，该策略可捕获肿瘤内 TLS 状态组成，并实现跨癌症和治疗环境的稳健患者分层。总之，这项工作为 TLS 分析建立了可推广和临床可扩展的框架，并强调 TLS 状态组成是具有转化相关性的肿瘤免疫组织的关键维度。它还为临床环境中基于 TLS 的生物标志物的前瞻性评估奠定了基础。

source_fragments: TME, and clinical relevance have not been systematically characterized at scale across cancer types. In this study, we used ST data to build a pancancer atlas of TLSs across 12 cancer types, with ultrahigh-plex, singlecell-resolved spatial RNA and protein profiling providing orthogonal validation in selected cohorts and integrated these findings with histopathology and clinical data. By developing a scalable AI-enabled framework to detect and classify TLSs directly from routine H&E WSIs, we have extended TLS analysis from limited spatial datasets to thousands of tumors. Leveraging this scalability, we have introduced a TLS maturationaware composite scoring strategy that captures within-tumor TLS state composition and enables robust patient stratification across cancers and treatment contexts. Together, this work establishes generalizable and clinically scalable frameworks for TLS profiling and highlights TLS state composition as a key dimension of tumor immune organization with translational relevance. It also provides a foundation for prospective evaluation of TLS-informed biomarkers in clinical settings.

english.text: Across cancer types, TLSs were neither spatially uniform nor immunologically equivalent. TLS localization and maturation states varied substantially by tumor type and tissue context, with TLSs distributed across IT, PT, and DT regions in tumor type–specific patterns. Con sistent with this view, in ST cohorts with richer clinical annotations, TLS prevalence and maturation also showed associations with tumorintrinsic and etiologic contexts (e.g., KRAS status in CRC, HBV status in LIHC, and MTAP loss in BLCA) (38, 40, 42), suggesting that tumor genetics, tissue context, and inflammatory milieu can differentially support or constrain TLS formation and maturation. Although these observations are based on relatively small cohorts, they motivate larger, subtype-resolved studies to more definitively link TLS evolution to tumor biology. Applying the AI framework at scale further revealed that TLS maturation frequently, but not uniformly, tracked with tumor stage, with progressive enrichment of more mature TLS states in earlyto-intermediate stages and attenuation of this association in advanced stages. Together, these patterns suggest that TLS maturation reflects dynamic interactions between tumor progression and local immune organization rather than a fixed protective phenotype.

chinese.text: 在不同的癌症类型中，TLS 既不具有空间一致性，也不具有免疫学等效性。 TLS 定位和成熟状态因肿瘤类型和组织环境而异，TLS 以肿瘤类型特异性模式分布在 IT、PT 和 DT 区域。与这一观点一致，在具有更丰富临床注释的 ST 队列中，TLS 患病率和成熟也显示与肿瘤内在和病因背景相关（例如 CRC 中的 KRAS 状态、LIHC 中的 HBV 状态和 BLCA 中的 MTAP 丢失）（38,40,42），表明肿瘤遗传学、组织背景和炎症环境可以不同地支持或限制 TLS 的形成和成熟。尽管这些观察结果基于相对较小的队列，但它们激发了更大规模、亚型解析的研究，以更明确地将 TLS 进化与肿瘤生物学联系起来。大规模应用人工智能框架进一步表明，TLS 的成熟度经常但不均匀地与肿瘤阶段相关，在早期到中期阶段，更成熟的 TLS 状态逐渐丰富，而在晚期阶段，这种关联逐渐减弱。总之，这些模式表明 TLS 成熟反映了肿瘤进展和局部免疫组织之间的动态相互作用，而不是固定的保护表型。

source_fragments: Across cancer types, TLSs were neither spatially uniform nor immunologically equivalent. TLS localization and maturation states varied substantially by tumor type and tissue context, with TLSs distributed across IT, PT, and DT regions in tumor type–specific patterns. Con sistent with this view, in ST cohorts with richer clinical annotations, TLS prevalence and maturation also showed associations with tumorintrinsic and etiologic contexts (e.g., KRAS status in CRC, HBV status in LIHC, and MTAP loss in BLCA) (38, 40, 42), suggesting that tumor genetics, tissue context, and inflammatory milieu can differentially support or constrain TLS formation and maturation. Although these observations are based on relatively small cohorts, they motivate larger, subtype-resolved studies to more definitively link TLS evolution to tumor biology. Applying the AI framework at scale further revealed that TLS maturation frequently, but not uniformly, tracked with tumor stage, with progressive enrichment of more mature TLS states in earlyto-intermediate stages and attenuation of this association in advanced stages. Together, these patterns suggest that TLS maturation reflects dynamic interactions between tumor progression and local immune organization rather than a fixed protective phenotype.

english.text: Our analyses revealed that TLS maturation is accompanied by coordinated multicompartment niche remodeling within the TME. TLSs follow a progressive trajectory from E-TLSs to P-TLSs and ultimately S-TLSs (1, 16), marked by coordinated enrichment of immune and stromal programs. As TLSs matured, we observed increased representation of activated T and B cell populations, specialized effector and regulatory subsets (e.g., Breg-like cells), and chemokine and cytokine networks that support structured B cell–T cell interactions (9, 28). These changes likely facilitate compartmentalized immune activation while concurrently engaging immunoregulatory programs that contribute to local immune homeostasis (27, 35, 36, 53–56). In parallel, TLS maturation involves progressive engagement of antigen-presenting cells (57–59), shifts in macrophage phenotypes (60–65), and increasing specialization of endothelial cells and fibroblasts (65–67), together with vascular remodeling that facilitates immune cell recruitment and retention, and spatial organization. These multicompartmental changes are further reinforced by stress-adaptive transcriptional programs, including heat-shock and IFN-stimulated responses, which may help maintain TLS integrity and function under inflammatory and metabolic stress. Collectively, these features suggest that mature TLSs are not simply “more immune” but that they represent stabilized, selfsupporting niches that can sustain local immune organization under inflammatory and metabolic stress (68–70).

chinese.text: 我们的分析表明，TLS 的成熟伴随着 TME 内协调的多室利基重塑。 TLS 遵循从 E-TLS 到 P-TLS 并最终到 S-TLS 的渐进轨迹 (1, 16)，其特点是免疫和基质程序的协调丰富。随着 TLS 的成熟，我们观察到活化的 T 和 B 细胞群、专门的效应子和调节子集（例如 Breg 样细胞）以及支持结构化 B 细胞-T 细胞相互作用的趋化因子和细胞因子网络的代表性增加 (9, 28)。这些变化可能促进区室化免疫激活，同时参与有助于局部免疫稳态的免疫调节程序（27,35,36,53-56）。与此同时，TLS 成熟涉及抗原呈递细胞的逐步参与 (57-59)、巨噬细胞表型的转变 (60-65)、内皮细胞和成纤维细胞日益专业化 (65-67)，以及促进免疫细胞招募和保留以及空间组织的血管重塑。这些多室变化通过应激适应性转录程序（包括热休克和 IFN 刺激反应）进一步强化，这可能有助于在炎症和代谢应激下维持 TLS 的完整性和功能。总的来说，这些特征表明成熟的 TLS 不仅仅是“免疫能力更强”，而且它们代表了稳定的、自我支持的生态位，可以在炎症和代谢应激下维持局部免疫组织 (68-70)。

In parallel, TLS maturation involves progressive engagement of antigen-presenting cells (57–59), shifts in macrophage phenotypes (60–65), and increasing specialization of endothelial cells and fibroblasts (65–67), together with vascular remodeling that facilitates immune cell recruitment and retention, and spatial organization. These multicompartmental changes are further reinforced by stress-adaptive transcriptional programs, including heat-shock and IFN-stimulated responses, which may help maintain TLS integrity and function under inflammatory and metabolic stress. english.text: Although prior studies have implicated TLSs in regulating local immune responses (1, 5, 9, 16, 29, 36 ), our pan-cancer analysis provides a systematic view that links TLSs to the spatial logic of immune-tumor patterning within the TME. Rather than passive byproducts of immune infiltration, TLSs appear to both mark (and potentially help maintain) spatially compartmentalized immune activation at tumor interfaces. We found that TLS proximity was associated with consistent spatial gradients across cancers, with immune activation enriched in TLSproximal tumor regions and proliferative and invasive programs enriched distally (23). We further identified ligand-receptor axes with established immunological roles that align with these proinflammatory gradients. The TNFSF14-TNFRSF14 (LIGHT-HVEM) axis regulates local immune activation and has been shown to enhance antitumor immunity (71). The CXCL10/11-CXCR3 axis is a canonical pathway for effector cell recruitment, consistent with inflammatory signaling observed in TLS-proximal tumor regions (72, 73), whereas the CXCL16- CXCR6 axis has been implicated in chronic inflammation and effector-cell retention (74). Collectively, these findings support a model in which TLSs are embedded within short-range cytokine and chemokine fields that promote immune cell recruitment and retention and reinforce inflammatory signaling at TLS-tumor interfaces. The distancedependent immune gradients that we observed around IT TLSs may reflect multiple, nonmutually exclusive processes, including (i) localized cytokine or chemokine fields produced by TLS-associated immune cells, (ii) composition shifts driven by immune cell redistribution or retention near TLS borders, and (iii) localized transcriptional reprogramming of adjacent tumor and stromal cells, consistent with the spatially coordinated ligand-receptor patterns mapped at single-cell and subcellular resolution. These spatial associations are correlative; establishing causality will require functional perturbation and longitudinal, higher-resolution spatial profiling.

source_fragments: To evaluate clinical relevance, we applied our AI-based TLS framework at scale and introduced a stratification strategy based on TLS compositional maturation profiles. By summarizing within-tumor TLS state composition into a continuous score, this approach consistently outperformed conventional TLS metrics (21–24) in prognostic prediction across cancer types. Notably, the C1 group was associated with significantly improved OS independent of tumor stage, indicating that

english.text: TLS composition provides prognostic information beyond maturation state alone. These findings highlight a key limitation of existing TLS stratification strategies, which often collapse complex intratumoral TLS heterogeneity into binary or single-label classifications. In practice, individual tumors often harbor multiple TLSs spanning distinct maturation states, a feature that is lost when tumors are reduced to a single dominant category. Conceptually, these results argue that TLS “quality” is not captured by presence or a single dominant state but by the mixture and abundance of coexisting TLS states within a tumor, an axis of intratumoral immune organization that prior binary schemes erase. To our knowledge, this represents the first AI-enabled, proportion-aware TLS stratification framework that enables largescale TLS phenotyping and prognostic stratification directly from routine H&E images alone. Using this maturation-aware composite score, we demonstrate robust and reproducible associations with OS across independent cohorts.

chinese.text: TLS 成分提供了超越成熟状态的预后信息。这些发现凸显了现有 TLS 分层策略的一个关键局限性，该策略通常将复杂的肿瘤内 TLS 异质性分解为二元或单标签分类。在实践中，单个肿瘤通常具有跨越不同成熟状态的多个 TLS，当肿瘤减少到单一主导类别时，这一特征就会消失。从概念上讲，这些结果表明，TLS 的“质量”不是通过存在或单一主导状态来体现，而是通过肿瘤内共存 TLS 状态的混合和丰富程度来体现，肿瘤内免疫组织的轴是先前的二元方案所消除的。据我们所知，这代表了第一个支持人工智能、比例感知的 TLS 分层框架，可直接根据常规 H&E 图像进行大规模 TLS 表型分析和预后分层。使用这种成熟感知综合评分，我们在独立队列中证明了与 OS 的稳健且可重复的关联。

These findings highlight a key limitation of existing TLS stratification strategies, which often collapse complex intratumoral TLS heterogeneity into binary or single-label classifications. In practice, individual tumors often harbor multiple TLSs spanning distinct maturation states, a feature that is lost when tumors are reduced to a single dominant category. Conceptually, these results argue that TLS “quality” is not captured by presence or a single dominant state but by the mixture and abundance of coexisting TLS states within a tumor, an axis of intratumoral immune organization that prior binary schemes erase. To our knowledge, this represents the first AI-enabled, proportion-aware TLS stratification framework that enables largescale TLS phenotyping and prognostic stratification directly from routine H&E images alone. Using this maturation-aware composite score, we demonstrate robust and reproducible associations with OS across independent cohorts.

english.text: Extending these survival associations, enrichment of mature TLS states in responders across immunotherapy, chemotherapy, and targeted therapy cohorts suggests that TLS maturation may reflect a broader immunecompetent tissue state, not a feature restricted to immunotherapy response alone. Although chemotherapy, targeted therapy, and antiangiogenic agents do not directly target immune checkpoints, they can reshape the tumor immune microenvironment through immunogenic tumor cell death, antigen release, Fc-mediated effector mechanisms, and vascular or stromal remodeling. Mature TLSs are also associated with PC differentiation and antibody production, potentially supporting antibody-mediated effector functions (e.g., antibody-dependent cellular cytotoxicity and complement activation). In addition, their frequent colocalization with specialized vasculature (e.g., HEVs) may facilitate effector recruitment and local immune amplification. Together, these observations provide a plausible basis linking mature TLS enrichment to improved response and survival, although direct mechanistic testing is needed.

chinese.text: 扩展这些生存关联，免疫治疗、化疗和靶向治疗队列中应答者成熟 TLS 状态的丰富表明，TLS 成熟可能反映更广泛的免疫活性组织状态，而不仅仅是仅限于免疫治疗反应的特征。尽管化疗、靶向治疗和抗血管生成药物不直接针对免疫检查点，但它们可以通过免疫原性肿瘤细胞死亡、抗原释放、Fc介导的效应机制以及血管或基质重塑来重塑肿瘤免疫微环境。成熟的 TLS 还与 PC 分化和抗体产生相关，可能支持抗体介导的效应功能（例如抗体依赖性细胞毒性和补体激活）。此外，它们与特殊脉管系统（例如 HEV）的频繁共定位可能有助于效应器招募和局部免疫放大。总之，这些观察结果提供了一个合理的基础，将成熟的 TLS 富集与改善的反应和生存联系起来，尽管需要直接的机制测试。

Although chemotherapy, targeted therapy, and antiangiogenic agents do not directly target immune checkpoints, they can reshape the tumor immune microenvironment through immunogenic tumor cell death, antigen release, Fc-mediated effector mechanisms, and vascular or stromal remodeling. Mature TLSs are also associated with PC differentiation and antibody production, potentially supporting antibody-mediated effector functions (e.g., antibody-dependent cellular cytotoxicity and complement activation). In addition, their frequent colocalization with specialized vasculature (e.g., HEVs) may facilitate effector recruitment and local immune amplification. Together, these observations provide a plausible basis linking mature TLS enrichment to improved response and survival, although direct mechanistic testing is needed.

english.text: Collectively, these findings position TLS compositional maturation as a clinically scalable spatial phenotype and provide an AI-enabled path to quantify it from routine histology. Prospective studies should test whether TLS composition improves risk and response modeling beyond established clinicopathologic and molecular predictors, and whether TLS-informed stratification can guide clinical trial design or therapeutic modulation strategies.

chinese.text: 总的来说，这些发现将 TLS 成分成熟定位为临床可扩展的空间表型，并提供了一种人工智能支持的路径，可以从常规组织学中对其进行量化。前瞻性研究应测试 TLS 组合是否可以改善风险和反应模型，超越既定的临床病理学和分子预测因素，以及 TLS 知情的分层是否可以指导临床试验设计或治疗调节策略。

Prospective studies should test whether TLS composition improves risk and response modeling beyond established clinicopathologic and molecular predictors, and whether TLS-informed stratification can guide clinical trial design or therapeutic modulation strategies.

sections.title_zh: 研究的局限性

english.text: This study has several limitations. First, most ST datasets were generated using spot-level ST platforms. We applied resolution-enhancement approaches, orthogonal validation using single-cell ST and SP technologies, and spatial multimodal integration. However, current ST and SP platforms still lack validated reagents for isotype- and subclass-resolved plasmacell profiling. As spatial technologies advance, systematic cross-cancer dissection of TLS-associated antibody output, including antibody isotypes and subclasses and their clinical associations, will be an important direction for future work. Second, longitudinal spatial profiling will be essential to define how TLS maturation and compositional states evolve during tumor progression and in response to therapy. Third, available ST cohorts remain small and heterogeneous with variable clinical annotation; large, subtype-resolved datasets will be needed for definitive pan-cancer inference. Lastly, our analyses are correlative, and causal mechanisms governing TLS formation, maturation arrest, and immune function will require experimental perturbation in appropriate model systems. More broadly, TLSs are three-dimensional (3D) structures, and section-level sampling remains a limitation of current ST approaches; future studies integrating serial sections and nondisruptive 3D spatial profiling will be important to resolve TLS architecture in situ.

chinese.text: 这项研究有几个局限性。首先，大多数 ST 数据集是使用点级 ST 平台生成的。我们应用了分辨率增强方法、使用单细胞 ST 和 SP 技术的正交验证以及空间多模态积分。然而，当前的 ST 和 SP 平台仍然缺乏用于同种型和亚类解析浆细胞分析的经过验证的试剂。随着空间技术的进步，对 TLS 相关抗体输出的系统性跨癌解剖，包括抗体同种型和亚类及其临床关联，将是未来工作的重要方向。其次，纵向空间分析对于定义 TLS 成熟和成分状态在肿瘤进展过程中以及对治疗的反应中如何演变至关重要。第三，可用的 ST 队列仍然很小且异质，临床注释各异；确定的泛癌推断需要大型的、亚型解析的数据集。最后，我们的分析是相关的，控制 TLS 形成、成熟停滞和免疫功能的因果机制需要在适当的模型系统中进行实验扰动。更广泛地说，TLS 是三维 (3D) 结构，部分级采样仍然是当前 ST 方法的局限性；未来的研究集成串行截面和非破坏性 3D 空间分析对于解决原位 TLS 架构非常重要。

source_fragments: This study has several limitations. First, most ST datasets were generated using spot-level ST platforms. We applied resolution-enhancement approaches, orthogonal validation using single-cell ST and SP technologies, and spatial multimodal integration. However, current ST and SP platforms still lack validated reagents for isotype- and subclass-resolved plasmacell profiling. As spatial technologies advance, systematic cross-cancer dissection of TLS-associated antibody output, including antibody isotypes and subclasses and their clinical associations, will be an important direction for future work. Second, longitudinal spatial profiling will be essential to define how TLS maturation and compositional states evolve during tumor progression and in response to therapy. Third, available ST cohorts remain small and heterogeneous with variable clinical annotation; large, subtype-resolved datasets will be needed for definitive pan-cancer inference. Lastly, our analyses are correlative, and causal mechanisms governing TLS formation, maturation arrest, and immune function will require experimental perturbation in appropriate model systems. More broadly, TLSs are three-dimensional (3D) structures, and section-level sampling remains a limitation of current ST approaches; future studies integrating serial sections and nondisruptive 3D spatial profiling will be important to resolve TLS architecture in situ.

sections.title_zh: 人体标本

english.text: All human data presented in this study are de-identified to protect patient privacy. All human tumor tissues collected at The University of Texas MD Anderson Cancer Center were obtained from patients who provided signed informed consent and were under institutional review board (IRB)–approved protocols.

All human tumor tissues collected at The University of Texas MD Anderson Cancer Center were obtained from patients who provided signed informed consent and were under institutional review board (IRB)–approved protocols.

sections.title_zh: 胰腺腺癌（PAAD）

english.text: We collected Visium ST datasets from two cohorts of PAAD samples. The first cohort comprises 13 patients who were initially diagnosed with pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma (PDAC) and underwent a “warm” research autopsy within four hours post-mortem, conducted under the University of Nebraska Medical Center (UNMC) Rapid Autopsy Program under a protocol approved by their institutional review board (IRB #091-01). In total, 13 snap-frozen primary tumor tissue samples were obtained from these rapid autopsies. Written informed consent was obtained from all patients. Details of tissue collection, processing, and ST data generation have been described in our recent study by Pei et al. (75). The second cohort comprises 10 patients who were initially diagnosed with PDAC and were treatment-naïve at the time of sample collection. Details of tissue collection, processing, and ST data generation have been described in our recent study by Liu et al. (14). Written informed consent was obtained from all patients. Treatment-naïve tissues were collected under an IRBapproved protocol (PA15-0014) at The University of Texas MD Anderson Cancer Center.

Treatment-naïve tissues were collected under an IRBapproved protocol (PA15-0014) at The University of Texas MD Anderson Cancer Center.
