sections.title_zh: Visium ST 数据生成

english.text: ST was performed using the 10x Genomics Visium platform following manufacturer’s protocols tailored to tissue preservation type. Fresh frozen (FF) PAAD and FFPE (BLCA, LUAD, STAD) samples were sectioned (10 μm for FF tissues; 5 μm for FFPE tissues), methanol-fixed (PAAD only), H&E-stained, and imaged at high resolution prior to library preparation. RNA quality was assessed using the Agilent TapeStation to determine RNA Integrity Number (RIN) for FF tissues (extracted with the RNeasy Mini Kit, Qiagen), or the Agilent RNA 6000 Pico Kit to determine DV200 for FFPE tissues (extracted with the RNeasy FFPE Kit, Qiagen). Libraries were prepared using Visium kits, direct slide capture for FF samples and CytAssist-enabled workflows for FFPE tissues, and were sequenced on Illumina NovaSeq platforms.

sections.title_en: Multiplex immunofluorescence with Akoya PhenoCycler-Fusion IO60 panel
sections.title_zh: 使用 Akoya PhenoCycler-Fusion IO60 面板进行多重免疫荧光

english.text: FFPE tissue sections (thickness typically 4–5 μm) were mounted onto poly- L-lysine–coated or charged glass slides and baked to ensure adhesion prior to staining. Multiplexed cyclic immunofluorescence was performed using the Akoya PhenoCycler-Fusion (formerly CODEX) platform with the IO60 immune-oncology antibody panel. All procedures followed the manufacturer’s recommended workflow for automated barcoded antibody staining and iterative imaging. Tissue sections underwent deparaffinization and antigen retrieval (citrate- or Tris-based buffer, heat-induced), followed by blocking to minimize nonspecific binding. A cocktail of DNA-barcoded primary antibodies corresponding to the IO60 panel was applied to the sections. After incubation and washing, the samples were loaded onto the PhenoCycler-Fusion system, which performs sequential hybridization and cleavage cycles. During each imaging cycle, complementary fluorescent reporters were hybridized, imaged, and stripped to enable visualization of the next set of markers. High-resolution imaging was acquired under standardized exposure settings with automated Z-stack or focal-plane optimization, as defined by the Akoya protocol. Raw images were aligned and unmixed using the PhenoCycler-Fusion software suite to correct for background and spectral overlap. Processed images were reviewed and quantified using QuPath software.

chinese.text: 将 FFPE 组织切片（厚度通常为 4-5 μm）固定在聚 L-赖氨酸涂层或带电载玻片上，并烘烤以确保染色前粘附。使用 Akoya PhenoCycler-Fusion（以前称为 CODEX）平台和 IO60 免疫肿瘤抗体组进行多重循环免疫荧光。所有程序均遵循制造商推荐的自动条形码抗体染色和迭代成像工作流程。组织切片经过脱蜡和抗原修复（基于柠檬酸盐或 Tris 的缓冲液，热诱导），然后进行封闭以尽量减少非特异性结合。将与 IO60 组相对应的 DNA 条形码一抗混合物应用于切片。孵育和清洗后，将样品加载到 PhenoCycler-Fusion 系统上，该系统执行连续的杂交和切割循环。在每个成像周期中，互补荧光报告基因被杂交、成像和剥离，以实现下一组标记的可视化。高分辨率成像是在标准化曝光设置下通过自动 Z 堆栈或焦平面优化获得的，如 Akoya 协议所定义。使用 PhenoCycler-Fusion 软件套件对原始图像进行对齐和混合，以校正背景和光谱重叠。使用 QuPath 软件对处理后的图像进行审查和量化。

sections.title_zh: 免疫荧光和免疫组织化学标记测定

english.text: FFPE human ccRCC (clear cell renal cell carcinoma) tumor and control specimens were cut into 3-4 μm-thick sections. Human FFPE tonsil sections and/or ccRCC test tumor sections (France Tissue Bank) were used as positive controls for BCL6, CD3, CD20, CD23, MUM1 (irf4), IgA and IgG. Antigen retrieval was carried out on a PT-link (Dako) using the EnVision FLEX Target Retrieval Solutions at High pH (Dako, K8004) or Low pH (Dako, K8005). Endogenous peroxidase activity and nonspecific Fc receptor binding were blocked with H2O2 3% (Gifrer, 10603051) and Protein Block (Dako, X0909), respectively. The primary and secondary antibodies used for IHC and IF are summarized in
table S6
. All images were independently analyzed by three reviewers. Necrotic and serous areas were excluded from image analyses.

sections.title_zh: 多重免疫荧光测定

english.text: The PNAd/CD20/CD23/BCL6 4-plex and the IgA/IgG/MUM1 3-plex stainings were performed manually on FFPE tumor sections using a tyramide system amplification (TSA) and a conventional fluorescentdye conjugated secondary antibody system (all secondary antibodies were diluted at 1:100). The panel combined PNAd, CD20, CD23, and BCL6 to define TLS architecture and maturation, together with MUM1 (IRF4), IgA, and IgG to assess ASC identity and isotype distribution. MUM1 (IRF4) was used as a nuclear marker of terminally differentiated ASCs and interpreted in conjunction with IgA/IgG expression and B-lineage context to ensure specificity. Nuclei were stained with DAPI Solution (Thermofisher, 62248) at 2 μg/ml for 10 min. After mounting with ProLongTM Gold Antifade Mountant (Thermofisher, P36934), the slides were scanned at 20X magnification using a Zeiss Axio scan Z1 device. Antibodies and TSA used are listed in
table S6

. Images were analyzed using Halo10 software (Indica labs) with appropriate cellcounting algorithms. TLS regions were identified based on CD3 (green) and CD20 (red) chromogenic staining on a consecutive slide.

sections.title_zh: 酶免疫组织化学法鉴定 TLS

english.text: Enzymatic immunohistochemical staining was performed manually to detect TLSs. Chromogenic detection was performed using HighDef red IHC chromogen (AP) (Enzo, ADI-950-140-0030) for CD20, Permanent HRP Green (Zytomed Systems, ZUC070-100) for CD3. The nuclei were counterstained with hematoxylin (Dako, S3301). After mounting with EcoMount (Biocare Medical, EM897L), the slides were scanned with a NanoZoomer (Hamamatsu). TLSs were identified using the registration module to fit one slide on the other (Halo10 software, Indica labs). Tumors were considered TLS-positive when a CD3 aggregate with CD20 staining was found with surface above 7000 μm2, containing at least 100 cells, as quantified with Halo10 software (Indica labs).

chinese.text: 手动进行酶免疫组织化学染色来检测 TLS。使用 HighDef 红色 IHC 显色剂 (AP) (Enzo, ADI-950-140-0030) 对 CD20 进行显色检测，使用永久 HRP Green (Zytomed Systems, ZUC070-100) 对 CD3 进行显色检测。细胞核用苏木精（Dako，S3301）复染色。用 EcoMount（Biocare Medical，EM897L）安装后，用 NanoZoomer（Hamamatsu）扫描载玻片。使用配准模块将一张载玻片安装在另一张载玻片上（Halo10 软件，Indica 实验室）来识别 TLS。当发现 CD20 染色的 CD3 聚集体表面大于 7000 μm2、包含至少 100 个细胞（用 Halo10 软件（Indica labs）定量）时，肿瘤被认为是 TLS 阳性。

sections.title_zh: Xenium 数据生成

english.text: For each tissue block, H&E-stained sections were first reviewed to ensure suitable morphology, section integrity, stain uniformity, and image resolution. Criteria included the absence of folding, tearing, or detachment; appropriate stain intensity; and sufficient clarity without blurring or contrast loss. Only samples passing all quality checks proceeded to Xenium processing. For whole-tissue experiments, 11 × 11 mm regions corresponding to areas previously profiled by Visium were selected and paired on Xenium slides. Tissues were processed on the Xenium Analyzer (10x Genomics, model 1000481) according to the Xenium Prime 5K in situ gene expression protocol (CG000760). All hybridization, imaging, and decoding steps were conducted as instructed in the manufacturer’s workflow.

sections.title_en: Visium data processing and quality control
sections.title_zh: Visium 数据处理和质量控制

english.text: The detailed Visium data processing and quality control (QC) have been previously described in our recent studies (14, 75, 76). Briefly, the demultiplexed raw sequencing data were aligned to the human reference genome build GRCh38 (hg38) using the Space Ranger analysis pipeline (v3.0.2) from 10x Genomics with default settings to generate genelevel unique molecular identifier (UMI) count matrices. For basic filtering, spots with low-complexity libraries (e.g., nUMI < 500 or nFeature < 200) were excluded. Additionally, non-informative spots corresponding to technical artifacts or background (e.g., spots without tissue) were removed based on manual inspection using the Loupe Browser.

chinese.text: 详细的 Visium 数据处理和质量控制 (QC) 之前已在我们最近的研究中进行了描述 (14,75,76)。简而言之，使用来自 10x Genomics 的 Space Ranger 分析管道 (v3.0.2)，使用默认设置将多路分离的原始测序数据与人类参考基因组构建 GRCh38 (hg38) 进行比对，以生成基因级唯一分子标识符 (UMI) 计数矩阵。对于基本过滤，排除具有低复杂性库的点（例如，nUMI < 500 或 nFeature < 200）。此外，根据使用放大浏览器的手动检查，删除了与技术伪影或背景相对应的非信息点（例如，没有组织的点）。

Briefly, the demultiplexed raw sequencing data were aligned to the human reference genome build GRCh38 (hg38) using the Space Ranger analysis pipeline (v3.0.2) from 10x Genomics with default settings to generate genelevel unique molecular identifier (UMI) count matrices. For basic filtering, spots with low-complexity libraries (e.g., nUMI < 500 or nFeature < 200) were excluded. Additionally, non-informative spots corresponding to technical artifacts or background (e.g., spots without tissue) were removed based on manual inspection using the Loupe Browser.

sections.title_zh: 基因表达增强

english.text: To enhance the resolution of tissue architecture, we used iStar (25), an integrative approach that combines ST with histological features. For each sample, the input data included the H&E image, spot-level gene count matrix, spatial coordinates, physical pixel size (in μm), number of pixels per spot radius, and a binary tissue mask. The H&E image was rescaled to 0.5 × 0.5 μm2 per pixel to align its spatial resolution with the transcriptomics data. Histological features were then extracted from image patches (16 × 16 pixels, corresponding to 8 × 8 μm2) centered on each ST spot. A four-layer feedforward neural network was trained to map these histological features to the corresponding spotlevel gene expression using mean squared error loss. The model was trained for 400 epochs with a batch size of 128 and a learning rate of 1 × 10−4 using the Adam optimizer. After training, the model was applied across the entire tissue section to predict gene expression at the pixel level. The resulting enhanced gene expression values were normalized using min–max scaling to the [0,1] range. By achieving highresolution mapping, iStar facilitates detailed insights into the cellular and molecular architecture of the tissue, supporting advanced analyses in tissue segmentation and TME characterization.

chinese.text: 为了提高组织结构的分辨率，我们使用了 iStar (25)，这是一种将 ST 与组织学特征相结合的综合方法。对于每个样本，输入数据包括 H&E 图像、点级基因计数矩阵、空间坐标、物理像素大小（以 μm 为单位）、每个点半径的像素数和二元组织掩模。 H&E 图像被重新调整为每像素 0.5 × 0.5 μm2，以使其空间分辨率与转录组学数据保持一致。然后从以每个 ST 点为中心的图像块（16 × 16 像素，对应于 8 × 8 μm2）中提取组织学特征。训练四层前馈神经网络，使用均方误差损失将这些组织学特征映射到相应的点级基因表达。使用 Adam 优化器对该模型进行了 400 个周期的训练，批量大小为 128，学习率为 1 × 10−4。训练后，该模型应用于整个组织切片以预测像素水平的基因表达。使用最小-最大缩放将所得的增强基因表达值归一化至 [0,1] 范围。通过实现高分辨率绘图，iStar 有助于详细了解组织的细胞和分子结构，支持组织分割和 TME 表征的高级分析。

sections.title_en: TLS detection, segmentation, extraction, and labeling
sections.title_zh: TLS 检测、分割、提取和标记

english.text: We applied a standardized procedure for detecting, segmenting, extracting, and labeling TLSs across all ST samples. First, we calculated the TLS score for each imputed pixel by averaging the expression levels of TLS signature genes, as detailed in
table S3

and previously reported (25). This TLS score provided a quantitative measure of TLS intensity at each pixel, enabling accurate identification and spatial localization of TLSs (25). To minimize false positives, we also carefully checked the TLS scores by cross-referencing them with spot-level expression of T cell marker (CD3D) and B cell marker (MS4A1) without imputation and the identified TLSs were further carefully reviewed by our experienced pathologists for accuracy.

chinese.text: 我们应用了标准化程序来检测、分割、提取和标记所有 ST 样本中的 TLS。首先，我们通过平均 TLS 签名基因的表达水平来计算每个估算像素的 TLS 分数，如表 S3 和之前报道的 (25) 中详述。该 TLS 分数提供了每个像素 TLS 强度的定量测量，从而实现了 TLS 的准确识别和空间定位 (25)。为了最大限度地减少假阳性，我们还通过将 TLS 分数与 T 细胞标记物 (CD3D) 和 B 细胞标记物 (MS4A1) 的点水平表达进行交叉引用来仔细检查，而无需插补，并且我们经验丰富的病理学家进一步仔细审查了确定的 TLS 的准确性。

source_fragments: We applied a standardized procedure for detecting, segmenting, extracting, and labeling TLSs across all ST samples. First, we calculated the TLS score for each imputed pixel by averaging the expression levels of TLS signature genes, as detailed in table S3 and previously reported (25). This TLS score provided a quantitative measure of TLS intensity at each pixel, enabling accurate identification and spatial localization of TLSs (25). To minimize false positives, we also carefully checked the TLS scores by cross-referencing them with spot-level expression of T cell marker (CD3D) and B cell marker (MS4A1) without imputation and the identified TLSs were further carefully reviewed by our experienced pathologists for accuracy.

english.text: Unsupervised TLS clustering was then performed based on calculated TLS scores. Prior to clustering, TLS scores were smoothed using a moving average over consecutive windows of 32 × 32 pixels to reduce noise and highlight local trends in the ST data. The smoothed scores were then clustered using the k-means algorithm, with k = 5 selected as the optimal number of clusters based on manual inspection. Clusters containing fewer than 20 pixels were subsequently discarded to enhance robustness and minimize the influence of noise. Following clustering, segmented TLS regions of the corresponding H&E image were carefully reviewed and confirmed by our experienced pathologists to ensure that each segmented area captured a TLS. To segment individual TLSs, we applied connected component labeling using the “label” function from the scipy.ndimage module in SciPy (v1.10.1) (95) with default settings in Python. Each TLS was then assigned a unique identifier, along with its corresponding ST data and paired H&E image, facilitating consistent tracking of individual TLSs across samples and downstream analyses. Lastly, TLS size was calculated by measuring the number of pixels within each segmented region. Given that each pixel corresponds to an area of 0.5 × 0.5 μm2, the total area of each TLS was computed by multiplying the pixel count by 0.25 μm2.

chinese.text: 然后根据计算的 TLS 分数执行无监督 TLS 聚类。在聚类之前，使用 32 × 32 像素的连续窗口上的移动平均值对 TLS 分数进行平滑处理，以减少噪声并突出 ST 数据中的局部趋势。然后使用 k 均值算法对平滑后的分数进行聚类，根据手动检查选择 k = 5 作为最佳聚类数。随后丢弃包含少于 20 个像素的簇，以增强鲁棒性并最大限度地减少噪声的影响。聚类后​​，我们经验丰富的病理学家仔细审查和确认了相应 H&E 图像的分割 TLS 区域，以确保每个分割区域捕获了 TLS。为了分割各个 TLS，我们使用 SciPy (v1.10.1) (95) 中 scipy.ndimage 模块中的“label”函数以及 Python 中的默认设置来应用连接组件标记。然后为每个 TLS 分配一个唯一的标识符及其相应的 ST 数据和配对的 H&E 图像，从而促进跨样本和下游分析对单个 TLS 的一致跟踪。最后，通过测量每个分割区域内的像素数量来计算 TLS 大小。鉴于每个像素对应的面积为 0.5 × 0.5 μm2，每个 TLS 的总面积通过将像素数乘以 0.25 μm2 来计算。

The smoothed scores were then clustered using the k-means algorithm, with k = 5 selected as the optimal number of clusters based on manual inspection. Clusters containing fewer than 20 pixels were subsequently discarded to enhance robustness and minimize the influence of noise. Following clustering, segmented TLS regions of the corresponding H&E image were carefully reviewed and confirmed by our experienced pathologists to ensure that each segmented area captured a TLS. To segment individual TLSs, we applied connected component labeling using the “label” function from the scipy.ndimage module in SciPy (v1.10.1) (95) with default settings in Python. Each TLS was then assigned a unique identifier, along with its corresponding ST data and paired H&E image, facilitating consistent tracking of individual TLSs across samples and downstream analyses. Lastly, TLS size was calculated by measuring the number of pixels within each segmented region. sections.title_zh: TLS 分类和转录组分析

english.text: To characterize TLSs at different maturation states based on their transcriptomic profiles, we applied log2-transformation followed by z-score normalization across all TLSs on a per-gene basis. This approach stabilized variance and enabled cross-sample comparability while preserving the relative expression dynamics essential for downstream clustering and TLS maturation classification. Following normalization, TLSs were stratified by maturation state based on the spatial expression patterns of key follicular and germinal center (GC) markers. For each TLS, we quantified the expression of follicular dendritic cell (FDC) markers CR2 and FCER2 by computing the 95th percentile of their expression values across all pixels within the TLS. These marker values were then used as input for k-means clustering (k=2) to classify TLSs into early TLSs (E-TLSs), which lack FDC presence, and mature TLSs (mTLSs), which show strong FDC marker expression. To further resolve the maturation states of mTLSs, we applied a similar strategy using GC-associated markers MKI67 and BCL6, again computing the 95th percentile expression values within each TLS. A second round of k-means clustering (k=2) was performed, further classifying mTLSs into P-TLSs, which lack GC-related marker expression (e.g., BCL6, MKI67), and S-TLSs, which show high GC-related marker expression.

sections.title_en: Pseudo-Visium spot synthesis from Xenium data
sections.title_zh: 根据 Xenium 数据进行伪 Visium 点合成

english.text: To simulate Visium-style data from Xenium outputs, pseudo-Visium H&E images were first cropped from Xenium H&E images. Pixel coordinates were converted to micrometers using a calibrated scale of 0.85 μm per pixel. A hexagonal spot lattice emulating the geometry of Visium v1/v2 (55 μm spot diameter; 27.5 μm radius) was then tiled across the ROI. Grid centers were generated in image coordinates with half-row staggering, and the grid was initiated half a spot beyond the image boundaries to ensure full peripheral coverage. Only spots whose circular bounding areas intersected the ROI were retained. For each spot, array row and column indices, center coordinates in both pixels and micrometers, spot diameter, and nominal spacing were recorded in a CSV file. Xenium per-molecule transcript coordinates were then assigned to pseudo-Visium spots by mapping each transcript to the nearest spot center within a 27.5 μm radius. Spot-level gene expression matrices were generated by summing transcript counts per gene within each spot. Unless specified otherwise, no molecule weighting or deconvolution was applied beyond this in-radius assignment. Qual ity control steps removed spots with low total transcript counts (e.g., <200 UMIs), and nontissue areas were optionally excluded using an H&E-derived tissue mask prior to counting. The resulting outputs included: (i) a spot-location file containing pixel and micrometer coordinates for all synthesized spots; (ii) a spot-by-gene count matrix formatted for downstream Visium-style analysis; and (iii) pseudo- Visium H&E images.

chinese.text: 为了模拟来自 Xenium 输出的 Visium 风格数据，首先从 Xenium H&E 图像中裁剪伪 Visium H&E 图像。使用每像素 0.85 μm 的校准刻度将像素坐标转换为微米。然后将模拟 Visium v​​1/v2 几何形状的六边形点阵（点直径 55 μm；半径 27.5 μm）平铺在 ROI 上。网格中心是在图像坐标中以半行交错生成的，并且网格在图像边界之外的半点处启动，以确保完全覆盖外围。仅保留圆形边界区域与 ROI 相交的点。对于每个点，阵列行和列索引、像素和微米的中心坐标、点直径和标称间距都记录在 CSV 文件中。然后通过将每个转录本映射到 27.5 μm 半径内最近的点中心，将 Xenium 每分子转录本坐标分配给伪 Visium 点。通过对每个点内每个基因的转录本计数求和来生成点水平基因表达矩阵。除非另有说明，否则除此半径内分配外，不应用分子加权或反卷积。质量控制步骤去除了总转录本计数较低（例如 <200 UMI）的斑点，并且在计数之前使用 H&E 衍生的组织掩模选择性地排除非组织区域。由此产生的输出包括：（i）包含所有合成点的像素和微米坐标的点位置文件； (ii) 为下游 Visium 式分析而格式化的逐基因计数矩阵； (iii) 伪 Visium H&E 图像。

sections.title_en: Xenium cell type and state identification
sections.title_zh: Xenium 细胞类型和状态识别

english.text: Output data from Xenium 5K assays, including gene count matrices, metadata, cellular centroid and boundary coordinates, and transcript coordinates, were processed for transcriptomic and spatial analyses. Initial quality control removed cells with fewer than 30 detected genes as well as cells lacking expression of canonical lineage markers. Data were normalized using the ‘SCTransform’ function in Seurat (v5.1.0) (103). PCA was performed on highly variable genes, and elbow plots were used to determine the number of dimensions for downstream analysis. A nearest-neighbor graph was constructed with ‘FindNeighbors’, followed by Louvain clustering using ‘FindClusters.’ UMAP was applied for non-linear dimensional reduction and visualization (103, 104).

chinese.text: Xenium 5K 检测的输出数据（包括基因计数矩阵、元数据、细胞质心和边界坐标以及转录本坐标）经过处理，用于转录组学和空间分析。初始质量控制去除了检测到的基因少于 30 个的细胞以及缺乏典型谱系标记表达的细胞。使用 Seurat (v5.1.0) 中的“SCTransform”函数对数据进行标准化 (103)。对高度可变的基因进行 PCA，并使用肘图来确定下游分析的维度数。使用“FindNeighbors”构建最近邻图，然后使用“FindClusters”进行 Louvain 聚类。UMAP 用于非线性降维和可视化 (103, 104)。

Initial quality control removed cells with fewer than 30 detected genes as well as cells lacking expression of canonical lineage markers. Data were normalized using the ‘SCTransform’ function in Seurat (v5.1.0) (103). PCA was performed on highly variable genes, and elbow plots were used to determine the number of dimensions for downstream analysis. A nearest-neighbor graph was constructed with ‘FindNeighbors’, followed by Louvain clustering using ‘FindClusters.’ UMAP was applied for non-linear dimensional reduction and visualization (103, 104).

english.text: Differentially expressed genes (DEGs) for each cluster were identified with ‘FindAllMarkers’, and top DEGs were reviewed alongside canonical lineage markers as reported previously (97, 98, 105, 106). Major cell compartments were annotated, including T cells (e.g., CD3D, CD2), B and PCs (MS4A1, CD79A for B cells; MZB1, XBP1 for PCs), myeloid cells (CD68, CD163 for macrophages; CSF3R for neutrophils; KIT, MS4A2 for mast cells; CD1A, CD1C, LAMP3 for DCs), stromal cells (COL5A1, PDGFRA for cancer-associated fibroblasts (CAFs); VWF, PECAM1, CD34 for endothelial cells; MYH11 for smooth muscle cells), epithelial cells (EPCAM, CDH1), and tumor cells (CDK1 and MKI67). In addition, regulatory B cells (Bregs) were further identified based on IL10 gene expression (107). Cell type annotations were mapped back to tissue images in Xenium Explorer for visualization and validation against cellular morphology.

sections.title_zh: Xenium TLS 识别

english.text: TLS identification in Xenium samples followed a two-stage strategy depending on the availability of an adjacent Visium ST section. When an adjacent Visium ST section was available, TLSs were first identified using our ST-based TLS detection framework and manually verified on the corresponding Xenium slide. Otherwise, TLSs were delineated on the H&E image using the H&E-based TLS detection algorithm described below. The H&E section was then co-registered to the Xenium morphology image in Xenium Explorer. We exported the affine transformation matrix from Xenium Explorer and used it to map TLS segmentation coordinates from the H&E image space into the Xenium single-cell coordinate space. Formally, for a point in H&E pixel coordinates, the transformed Xenium coordinates were computed using a homogeneous-coordinate affine transformation:

english.text: TLS labels were then assigned at single-cell resolution by determining whether each Xenium cell boundary, or alternatively its centroid, fell within the transformed TLS polygons.

sections.title_zh: 肿瘤斑点识别

english.text: To identify tumor spots from Visium ST data, we applied SpatialInferCNV (108) (https://aerickso.github.io/SpatialInferCNV/) in R, based on the inferCNV framework (108), as we previously described (75). The analysis was performed using the following parameters: cutoff = 0.1, cluster_ by_groups = FALSE, HMM = FALSE, and denoise = TRUE. Specifically, we followed a multi-step approach as outlined in our recent study (75). To ensure reliable results, we employed an integrative approach involving multiple rounds of selection to identify suitable non-tumor reference spots for copy number variant (CNV) calling. Reference spots were selected based on two criteria: (i) histological annotation as “nontumor” and (ii) transcriptional distinctiveness from tumor spots, as indicated by UMAP embedding (i.e., topographically distant from tumor cell clusters). To ensure that we selected true “non-tumor” spots without contamination of tumor cells, we further excluded any reference spots that displayed evidence of CNV events despite being histologically labeled as “non-tumor.” For CNV benchmarking, we selected at least two independent reference populations and performed Pearson correlation coefficient analysis to evaluate their concordance at the chromosomal band level across subclones. To ensure data quality, samples with weak or ambiguous inferCNV signals were excluded, and only those with reliable CNV profiles were retained for downstream analysis. For samples lacking CNV signals or identified as chromosomally stable tumors, tumor regions were manually annotated by our experienced pathologists using the corresponding H&E images.

chinese.text: 为了从 Visium ST 数据中识别肿瘤点，我们基于 inferCNV 框架 (108) 在 R 中应用了 SpatialInferCNV (108) (https://aerickso.github.io/SpatialInferCNV/)，如我们之前所述 (75)。使用以下参数进行分析：cutoff = 0.1、cluster_by_groups = FALSE、HMM = FALSE 和 denoise = TRUE。具体来说，我们遵循了最近研究 (75) 中概述的多步骤方法。为了确保结果可靠，我们采用了涉及多轮选择的综合方法来确定适合拷贝数变异（CNV）调用的非肿瘤参考点。根据两个标准选择参考点：（i）组织学注释为“非肿瘤”和（ii）肿瘤点的转录独特性，如 UMAP 嵌入所示（即，在拓扑上远离肿瘤细胞簇）。为了确保我们选择真正的“非肿瘤”点而不会污染肿瘤细胞，我们进一步排除了任何显示 CNV 事件证据的参考点，尽管在组织学上标记为“非肿瘤”。对于 CNV 基准测试，我们选择了至少两个独立的参考群体，并进行 Pearson 相关系数分析，以评估它们在亚克隆间染色体带水平上的一致性。为了确保数据质量，排除了 inferCNV 信号较弱或模糊的样本，仅保留具有可靠 CNV 特征的样本进行下游分析。对于缺乏 CNV 信号或被鉴定为染色体稳定肿瘤的样本，我们经验丰富的病理学家使用相应的 H&E 图像手动注释肿瘤区域。

To ensure that we selected true “non-tumor” spots without contamination of tumor cells, we further excluded any reference spots that displayed evidence of CNV events despite being histologically labeled as “non-tumor.” For CNV benchmarking, we selected at least two independent reference populations and performed Pearson correlation coefficient analysis to evaluate their concordance at the chromosomal band level across subclones. To ensure data quality, samples with weak or ambiguous inferCNV signals were excluded, and only those with reliable CNV profiles were retained for downstream analysis. For samples lacking CNV signals or identified as chromosomally stable tumors, tumor regions were manually annotated by our experienced pathologists using the corresponding H&E images.

sections.title_zh: TLS 位置识别

english.text: To categorize the spatial relationship between TLSs and tumor areas, we overlaid TLS coordinates with tumor spot annotations. TLSs located entirely within tumor spots were annotated as IT TLSs. TLSs positioned outside tumor spots but within 200 μm of the tumor-stromal interface (defined by the nearest tumor spots) were labeled as PT TLSs. TLSs situated beyond this proximity threshold were classified as DT TLSs. TLS location categories were further confirmed by our experienced pathologists. For samples with no or weak inferred CNV signals (i.e., chromosomally stable tumors), the spatial relationship between TLSs and tumor regions was determined based on pathology annotations of the corresponding H&E images. Pathology annotations for BRCA samples were obtained from the original study (51).

chinese.text: 为了对 TLS 和肿瘤区域之间的空间关系进行分类，我们将 TLS 坐标与肿瘤点注释重叠。完全位于肿瘤点内的 TLS 被注释为 IT TLS。位于肿瘤点外部但距肿瘤基质界面（由最近的肿瘤点定义）200 μm 以内的 TLS 被标记为 PT TLS。超出此接近阈值的 TLS 被归类为 DT TLS。我们经验丰富的病理学家进一步确认了 TLS 位置类别。对于没有或弱推断 CNV 信号的样本（即染色体稳定肿瘤），根据相应 H&E 图像的病理注释确定 TLS 和肿瘤区域之间的空间关系。 BRCA 样本的病理学注释来自原始研究 (51)。

TLSs located entirely within tumor spots were annotated as IT TLSs. TLSs positioned outside tumor spots but within 200 μm of the tumor-stromal interface (defined by the nearest tumor spots) were labeled as PT TLSs. TLSs situated beyond this proximity threshold were classified as DT TLSs. TLS location categories were further confirmed by our experienced pathologists. For samples with no or weak inferred CNV signals (i.e., chromosomally stable tumors), the spatial relationship between TLSs and tumor regions was determined based on pathology annotations of the corresponding H&E images. Pathology annotations for BRCA samples were obtained from the original study (51).

sections.title_en: Quantifying distance from an IT or DT TLS to surrounding tissue spots
sections.title_zh: 量化从 IT 或 DT TLS 到周围组织点的距离

english.text: To quantify the spatial relationship between TLSs and their surrounding microenvironment, TLS pixel coordinates were first converted to ST spots. Radial distances from the center of each TLS to all the spots were then calculated using the ‘RadialDistance’ function from the Semla (v1.2.1) package (109). For intra-tumoral TLSs (IT TLSs), only tumor spots were retained, while for distal-tumoral TLSs (DT TLSs) located in histologically normal regions, only non-tumor spots were retained. In both cases, distance values were rescaled to a 0–1 range to enable comparative distance analysis across samples. This standardized distance metric enabled us to investigate TLS proximity to tumor regions and assess potential associations between TLS location and TME characteristics.

chinese.text: 为了量化 TLS 与其周围微环境之间的空间关系，首先将 TLS 像素坐标转换为 ST 点。然后使用 Semla (v1.2.1) 包中的“RadialDistance”函数计算从每个 TLS 中心到所有点的径向距离 (109)。对于肿瘤内 TLS（IT TLS），仅保留肿瘤点，而对于位于组织学正常区域的远端肿瘤 TLS（DT TLS），仅保留非肿瘤点。在这两种情况下，距离值都重新调整为 0-1 范围，以便能够跨样本进行比较距离分析。这种标准化的距离度量使我们能够研究 TLS 与肿瘤区域的接近程度，并评估 TLS 位置和 TME 特征之间的潜在关联。

source_fragments: To quantify the spatial relationship between TLSs and their surrounding microenvironment, TLS pixel coordinates were first converted to ST spots. Radial distances from the center of each TLS to all the spots were then calculated using the ‘RadialDistance’ function from the Semla (v1.2.1) package (109). For intra-tumoral TLSs (IT TLSs), only tumor spots were retained, while for distal-tumoral TLSs (DT TLSs) located in histologically normal regions, only non-tumor spots were retained. In both cases, distance values were rescaled to a 0–1 range to enable comparative distance analysis across samples. This standardized distance metric enabled us to investigate TLS proximity to tumor regions and assess potential associations between TLS location and TME characteristics.

sections.title_zh: 通路分析

english.text: To investigate tumor-TLS interactions, we quantified the activity of tumor-associated pathways in tumor-enriched spots using curated gene sets. These included Hallmark gene sets from the Molecular Signature Database (MSigDB), which represent key biological processes such as cell cycle, oncogenic pathways, metabolic related pathways, and antigen presentation (110). We also calculated scores for tumor meta-programs that define key transcriptional states in tumors, including cell cycle regulation, stress response, EMT, antigen presentation, oncogenic signaling, metabolism, and lineage-specific differentiation (111). Additionally, we evaluated gene modules representing recurrent cancer cell states across tumor types, such as interferon response, hypoxia, oxidative phosphorylation, metal response, and EMT (77). Signature scores were computed using the ‘AUCell_run’ function from the AUCell package (112), which ranks genes by expression within each spot and calculates the Area Under the Curve (AUC) for recovery of each gene set within the top-ranked genes. Scores were calculated separately for each sample using lognormalized expression matrices, without additional scaling or centering, as AUCell relies on gene rankings rather than raw expression values.

chinese.text: 为了研究肿瘤-TLS 相互作用，我们使用策划的基因集量化了肿瘤富集点中肿瘤相关通路的活性。其中包括来自分子特征数据库 (MSigDB) 的 Hallmark 基因集，它们代表关键的生物过程，例如细胞周期、致癌途径、代谢相关途径和抗原呈递 (110)。我们还计算了肿瘤元程序的分数，这些元程序定义了肿瘤中的关键转录状态，包括细胞周期调节、应激反应、EMT、抗原呈递、致癌信号、代谢和谱系特异性分化 (111)。此外，我们还评估了代表不同肿瘤类型复发性癌细胞状态的基因模块，例如干扰素反应、缺氧、氧化磷酸化、金属反应和 EMT (77)。使用 AUCell 包 (112) 中的“AUCell_run”函数计算特征分数，该函数按每个点内的表达对基因进行排名，并计算曲线下面积 (AUC)，以恢复排名靠前的基因内的每个基因集。使用对数归一化表达矩阵分别计算每个样本的分数，无需额外缩放或居中，因为 AUCell 依赖于基因排名而不是原始表达值。

source_fragments: To investigate tumor-TLS interactions, we quantified the activity of tumor-associated pathways in tumor-enriched spots using curated gene sets. These included Hallmark gene sets from the Molecular Signature Database (MSigDB), which represent key biological processes such as cell cycle, oncogenic pathways, metabolic related pathways, and antigen presentation (110). We also calculated scores for tumor meta-programs that define key transcriptional states in tumors, including cell cycle regulation, stress response, EMT, antigen presentation, oncogenic signaling, metabolism, and lineage-specific differentiation (111). Additionally, we evaluated gene modules representing recurrent cancer cell states across tumor types, such as interferon response, hypoxia, oxidative phosphorylation, metal response, and EMT (77). Signature scores were computed using the ‘AUCell_run’ function from the AUCell package (112), which ranks genes by expression within each spot and calculates the Area Under the Curve (AUC) for recovery of each gene set within the top-ranked genes. Scores were calculated separately for each sample using lognormalized expression matrices, without additional scaling or centering, as AUCell relies on gene rankings rather than raw expression values.

english.text: To investigate spatial changes in pathway activity, we modeled pathway scores in relation to TLS proximity using the ‘differentialGeneTest’ function from the Monocle (v2.34.0) package in R (113). Using the function's default settings, we employed a natural spline with three degrees of freedom to fit pathway scores as a function of spatial distance from TLS. This approach allowed us to identify pathways exhibiting significant expression variation across TLS proximity gradients.

chinese.text: 为了研究通路活动的空间变化，我们使用 R (113) 中 Monocle (v2.34.0) 包中的“ DifferentialGeneTest”函数对与 TLS 邻近度相关的通路分数进行了建模。使用该函数的默认设置，我们采用具有三个自由度的自然样条来拟合路径分数作为距 TLS 空间距离的函数。这种方法使我们能够识别在 TLS 邻近梯度上表现出显着表达变化的途径。

source_fragments: To investigate spatial changes in pathway activity, we modeled pathway scores in relation to TLS proximity using the ‘differentialGeneTest’ function from the Monocle (v2.34.0) package in R (113). Using the function's default settings, we employed a natural spline with three degrees of freedom to fit pathway scores as a function of spatial distance from TLS. This approach allowed us to identify pathways exhibiting significant expression variation across TLS proximity gradients.

english.text: For pathways identified as significantly associated with TLS proximity, we generated smoothed expression curves using the ‘geneSmooth- Curves’ function from the Monocle package to discern expression trends with respect to TLS proximity. Similar to the ‘differentialGeneTest’ function, we employed a natural spline with three degrees of freedom. Pathway scores were smoothed across spatial distance from IT TLSs and z-score normalized for each pathway. Scores from spots nearest to the TLS (distance = 0), and the farthest spots (distance = 1), were used to classify expression trends. A score was considered low if the z-score was less than or equal to zero and high if it was greater than or equal to zero, relative to the pathway’s mean across all tumor-enriched spots distributed along the entire spatial gradient from the TLS. Based on the resulting profiles, we identified two major trends: high-to-low, where expression was elevated near a TLS and declined with distance, and low-to-high, where expression increased with distance from a TLS.

chinese.text: 对于确定与 TLS 邻近性显着相关的途径，我们使用 Monocle 包中的“geneSmooth-Curves”函数生成平滑的表达曲线，以辨别与 TLS 邻近性相关的表达趋势。与“differenceGeneTest”函数类似，我们采用了具有三个自由度的自然样条线。路径分数在 IT TLS 的空间距离上进行平滑处理，并且 z 分数对每个路径进行归一化。距离 TLS 最近的点（距离 = 0）和最远的点（距离 = 1）的分数用于对表达趋势进行分类。相对于沿着 TLS 的整个空间梯度分布的所有肿瘤富集点的通路平均值，如果 z 分数小于或等于 0，则分数被认为是低的；如果 z 分数大于或等于 0，则分数被认为是高的。根据所得的图谱，我们确定了两个主要趋势：从高到低，表达在 TLS 附近升高，并随着距离的增加而下降；从低到高，表达随着距 TLS 的距离增加而增加。

source_fragments: For pathways identified as significantly associated with TLS proximity, we generated smoothed expression curves using the ‘geneSmooth- Curves’ function from the Monocle package to discern expression trends with respect to TLS proximity. Similar to the ‘differentialGeneTest’ function, we employed a natural spline with three degrees of freedom. Pathway scores were smoothed across spatial distance from IT TLSs and z-score normalized for each pathway. Scores from spots nearest to the TLS (distance = 0), and the farthest spots (distance = 1), were used to classify expression trends. A score was considered low if the z-score was less than or equal to zero and high if it was greater than or equal to zero, relative to the pathway’s mean across all tumor-enriched spots distributed along the entire spatial gradient from the TLS. Based on the resulting profiles, we identified two major trends: high-to-low, where expression was elevated near a TLS and declined with distance, and low-to-high, where expression increased with distance from a TLS.

english.text: To identify spatially enriched pathways that were consistently observed across cancer types, we first aggregated samples by cancer type. We then identified pathways showing significant high-to-low or lowto-high trends within each type based on our differential analysis. For each pathway, we computed an enrichment proportion, defined as the fraction of cancer types in which the pathway showed significant spatial enrichment. We selected the five pathways with the highest enrichment proportions from each trend category (high-to-low and low-tohigh), yielding the top 10 pathways with the most consistent spatial expression patterns in relation to TLS proximity. To visualize these patterns, we generated heatmaps using the ‘plot_pseudotime_heatmap’ function in Monocle (v2.34.0) (113) and overlaid line plots using the ‘ggplot’ function in ggplot2 in R to display the smoothed pathway scores along the IT TLS distance gradient (102).

chinese.text: 为了确定在各种癌症类型中一致观察到的空间富集途径，我们首先按癌症类型聚合样本。然后，我们根据差异分析确定了每种类型中显示显着的从高到低或从低到高趋势的途径。对于每个通路，我们计算了富集比例，定义为该通路显示出显着空间富集的癌症类型的比例。我们从每个趋势类别（从高到低和从低到高）中选择了富集比例最高的 5 个路径，产生了与 TLS 邻近性相关的空间表达模式最一致的前 10 个路径。为了可视化这些模式，我们使用 Monocle (v2.34.0) 中的“plot_pseudotime_heatmap”函数生成热图 (113)，并使用 R 中 ggplot2 中的“ggplot”函数生成重叠线图，以显示沿 IT TLS 距离梯度的平滑路径分数 (102)。

We then identified pathways showing significant high-to-low or lowto-high trends within each type based on our differential analysis. For each pathway, we computed an enrichment proportion, defined as the fraction of cancer types in which the pathway showed significant spatial enrichment. We selected the five pathways with the highest enrichment proportions from each trend category (high-to-low and low-tohigh), yielding the top 10 pathways with the most consistent spatial expression patterns in relation to TLS proximity. To visualize these patterns, we generated heatmaps using the ‘plot_pseudotime_heatmap’ function in Monocle (v2.34.0) (113) and overlaid line plots using the ‘ggplot’ function in ggplot2 in R to display the smoothed pathway scores along the IT TLS distance gradient (102).

sections.title_en: Identifying ligands and receptors enriched within IT TLSs
sections.title_zh: 识别 IT TLS 中富集的配体和受体

english.text: spot-wise radial distances to each TLS using the ‘RadialDistance’ function in Semla (v1.2.1) (109). Spots with distance < 0 were classified as TLS core (inside), while the TLS margin was defined as spots located within 0–50 μm from the TLS boundary. When no spots were present in this window, a fallback margin of 0–100 μm was applied, and all analyses were restricted to tumor-annotated spots. For each intratumoral TLS, we compared gene expression between TLS core and TLS margin spots across cytokine and chemokine ligands and receptors. For every gene, we calculated the mean expression, the proportion of expressing spots, and the difference in mean expression (core – margin). Paired Wilcoxon signed-rank tests were then performed across TLSs to assess whether expression was significantly higher inside TLSs compared with their margins.

chinese.text: 使用 Semla (v1.2.1) (109) 中的“RadialDistance”函数计算到每个 TLS 的逐点径向距离。距离 < 0 的点被分类为 TLS 核心（内部），而 TLS 边缘被定义为距离 TLS 边界 0-50 μm 范围内的点。当该窗口中不存在斑点时，应用 0-100 μm 的回退裕度，并且所有分析仅限于肿瘤注释的斑点。对于每个肿瘤内 TLS，我们比较了细胞因子和趋化因子配体和受体的 TLS 核心点和 TLS 边缘点之间的基因表达。对于每个基因，我们计算了平均表达、表达点的比例以及平均表达差异（核心-边缘）。然后在 TLS 上进行配对 Wilcoxon 符号秩检验，以评估 TLS 内部的表达是否显着高于其边缘。

source_fragments: spot-wise radial distances to each TLS using the ‘RadialDistance’ function in Semla (v1.2.1) (109). Spots with distance < 0 were classified as TLS core (inside), while the TLS margin was defined as spots located within 0–50 μm from the TLS boundary. When no spots were present in this window, a fallback margin of 0–100 μm was applied, and all analyses were restricted to tumor-annotated spots. For each intratumoral TLS, we compared gene expression between TLS core and TLS margin spots across cytokine and chemokine ligands and receptors. For every gene, we calculated the mean expression, the proportion of expressing spots, and the difference in mean expression (core – margin). Paired Wilcoxon signed-rank tests were then performed across TLSs to assess whether expression was significantly higher inside TLSs compared with their margins.

sections.title_en: Gene-level analysis of spatial gradients relative to TLS proximity
sections.title_zh: 与 TLS 邻近度相关的空间梯度的基因水平分析

english.text: To investigate spatial expression gradients of individual cytokine and chemokine ligands and receptors with respect to intra-tumoral TLSs, we applied the same procedure used for modeling pathway scores in relation to TLS proximity. Spot-wise distances from TLSs were first computed using the ‘RadialDistance’ function in Semla (v1.2.1) (109). Gene expression trends were then modeled with the ‘geneSmoothCurves’ function in Monocle (v2.34.0) using a natural spline with three degrees of freedom, followed by z-score normalization per gene. Smoothed values across the TLS–tumor distance gradient were used to classify spatial profiles: expression that declined from TLS core (distance = 0) to distal tumor regions (distance = 0.75) was labeled “high-to-low” (113). To identify robust signals, results were aggregated across eight cancer types, and genes showing concordant trends in multiple types were prioritized.

chinese.text: 为了研究单个细胞因子和趋化因子配体和受体相对于肿瘤内 TLS 的空间表达梯度，我们应用了与 TLS 邻近度相关的通路评分建模相同的程序。首先使用 Semla (v1.2.1) 中的“RadialDistance”函数计算距 TLS 的逐点距离 (109)。然后使用具有三个自由度的自然样条，通过 Monocle (v2.34.0) 中的“geneSmoothCurves”功能对基因表达趋势进行建模，然后对每个基因进行 z 分数标准化。 TLS-肿瘤距离梯度的平滑值用于对空间概况进行分类：从 TLS 核心（距离 = 0）到远端肿瘤区域（距离 = 0.75）下降的表达被标记为“从高到低”（113）。为了识别强大的信号，汇总了八种癌症类型的结果，并优先考虑在多种类型中显示一致趋势的基因。

Spot-wise distances from TLSs were first computed using the ‘RadialDistance’ function in Semla (v1.2.1) (109). Gene expression trends were then modeled with the ‘geneSmoothCurves’ function in Monocle (v2.34.0) using a natural spline with three degrees of freedom, followed by z-score normalization per gene. Smoothed values across the TLS–tumor distance gradient were used to classify spatial profiles: expression that declined from TLS core (distance = 0) to distal tumor regions (distance = 0.75) was labeled “high-to-low” (113). To identify robust signals, results were aggregated across eight cancer types, and genes showing concordant trends in multiple types were prioritized.

sections.title_en: Tissue annotation, TLS spatial distribution, and tissue enrichment analysis
sections.title_zh: 组织注释、TLS 空间分布和组织富集分析

english.text: Spot-level pathologist annotations for tumor samples in the CRC cohort were obtained from the original study (38). For the BLCA cohort, spot-level histology annotation was performed by our board-certified pathologists. For the LIHC cohort, we examined the region-specific distribution of immune cells, stromal cells, and tumor cells by categorizing all ST spots into three groups based on their proximity to the tumor region: (i) Tumor region spots, which are entirely or predominantly composed of neoplastic cells; (ii) tumor boundary spots, located within the stroma immediately adjacent to the tumor region (typically the first one or two layers of spots, approximately within 200 μm of the tumor-normal interface); and (iii) nontumor spots, which are topographically distal from the tumor region and do not fall into either the tumor region or tumor boundary category, as recently described (75). To determine the spatial distribution of TLSs within tissue compartments annotated by pathologists, we overlaid TLS coordinates onto the pathologist-defined annotations. This allowed us to systematically determine the tissue compartment in which each TLS was located.

chinese.text: CRC 队列中肿瘤样本的现场病理学家注释来自原始研究 (38)。对于 BLCA 队列，点级组织学注释由我们委员会认证的病理学家进行。对于 LIHC 队列，我们​​通过根据与肿瘤区域的接近程度将所有 ST 点分为三组来检查免疫细胞、基质细胞和肿瘤细胞的区域特异性分布：（i）肿瘤区域点，完全或主要由肿瘤细胞组成； (ii) 肿瘤边界点，位于紧邻肿瘤区域的基质内（通常是前一层或两层点，大约在肿瘤-正常界面的 200 μm 内）； (iii)非肿瘤点，其在地形上远离肿瘤区域并且不属于肿瘤区域或肿瘤边界类别，如最近描述的(75)。为了确定病理学家注释的组织室内 TLS 的空间分布，我们将 TLS 坐标叠加到病理学家定义的注释上。这使我们能够系统地确定每个 TLS 所在的组织区室。

source_fragments: Spot-level pathologist annotations for tumor samples in the CRC cohort were obtained from the original study (38). For the BLCA cohort, spot-level histology annotation was performed by our board-certified pathologists. For the LIHC cohort, we examined the region-specific distribution of immune cells, stromal cells, and tumor cells by categorizing all ST spots into three groups based on their proximity to the tumor region: (i) Tumor region spots, which are entirely or predominantly composed of neoplastic cells; (ii) tumor boundary spots, located within the stroma immediately adjacent to the tumor region (typically the first one or two layers of spots, approximately within 200 μm of the tumor-normal interface); and (iii) nontumor spots, which are topographically distal from the tumor region and do not fall into either the tumor region or tumor boundary category, as recently described (75). To determine the spatial distribution of TLSs within tissue compartments annotated by pathologists, we overlaid TLS coordinates onto the pathologist-defined annotations. This allowed us to systematically determine the tissue compartment in which each TLS was located.

english.text: To evaluate the enrichment or depletion of TLSs in specific tissue compartments, we applied the Ro/e (ratio of observed to expected) approach, as previously described (98, 114). In short, we computed the ratio of the observed TLS count to its random expectation, using a χ2 test for each TLS maturation state across different tissue compartments. An Ro/e value greater than 1 indicates enrichment, whereas an Ro/e value less than 1 suggests depletion of TLSs in a given tissue compartment.

chinese.text: 为了评估特定组织区室中 TLS 的富集或消耗，我们应用了 Ro/e（观察到预期的比率）方法，如前所述 (98, 114)。简而言之，我们对不同组织区室中的每个 TLS 成熟状态使用 χ2 检验，计算了观察到的 TLS 计数与其随机期望的比率。 Ro/e 值大于 1 表明富集，而 Ro/e 值小于 1 表明给定组织区室中 TLS 被耗尽。

source_fragments: To evaluate the enrichment or depletion of TLSs in specific tissue compartments, we applied the Ro/e (ratio of observed to expected) approach, as previously described (98, 114). In short, we computed the ratio of the observed TLS count to its random expectation, using a χ2 test for each TLS maturation state across different tissue compartments. An Ro/e value greater than 1 indicates enrichment, whereas an Ro/e value less than 1 suggests depletion of TLSs in a given tissue compartment.

sections.title_en: Sample classification and correlative analysis with TLS features
sections.title_zh: 利用 TLS 特征进行样本分类和关联分析

english.text: To investigate associations between TLS maturation and clinical or molecular characteristics, we first quantified TLS features, including total TLS count and the relative abundance of each maturation state. Each sample was then classified into one of three categories, E-TLS, P-TLS, or S-TLS, based on which maturation state was most prevalent within the sample. Clinical variables evaluated across cohorts included tumor grade, tumor stage, KRAS and MTAP mutation status, HBV infection status, presence of metastasis, and chemotherapy response. Associations involving total TLS count and relative abundance were assessed using the Chi-square test, whereas relationships between TLS maturation-based sample classification and clinical features were evaluated using proportion tests.

chinese.text: 为了研究 TLS 成熟与临床或分子特征之间的关联，我们首先量化 TLS 特征，包括 TLS 总数和每个成熟状态的相对丰度。然后，根据样本中最普遍的成熟状态，将每个样本分为三个类别之一：E-TLS、P-TLS 或 S-TLS。跨队列评估的临床变量包括肿瘤分级、肿瘤分期、KRAS 和 MTAP 突变状态、HBV 感染状态、转移的存在和化疗反应。使用卡方检验评估涉及 TLS 总数和相对丰度的关联，而使用比例检验评估基于 TLS 成熟的样本分类和临床特征之间的关系。

source_fragments: To investigate associations between TLS maturation and clinical or molecular characteristics, we first quantified TLS features, including total TLS count and the relative abundance of each maturation state. Each sample was then classified into one of three categories, E-TLS, P-TLS, or S-TLS, based on which maturation state was most prevalent within the sample. Clinical variables evaluated across cohorts included tumor grade, tumor stage, KRAS and MTAP mutation status, HBV infection status, presence of metastasis, and chemotherapy response. Associations involving total TLS count and relative abundance were assessed using the Chi-square test, whereas relationships between TLS maturation-based sample classification and clinical features were evaluated using proportion tests.

sections.title_en: WSI analysis, TLS detection, and TLS maturation classification
sections.title_zh: WSI 分析、TLS 检测和 TLS 成熟分类

english.text: LUSC, KIRC, BLCA, LUAD, STAD, and COAD WSIs were obtained from the Genomic Data Commons (GDC) portal (115) (https://portal.gdc. cancer.gov/) and processed to identify and classify TLS maturation states. TLS detection was performed using HookNet-TLS (47), a deep learning-based segmentation model designed to detect TLSs in histopathological images. The model takes as input WSIs at two resolutions, high (0.5 μm/pixel) and low (2.0 μm/pixel), along with binary tissue masks indicating valid tissue areas. Default parameters were used, including a patch size of 512 × 512 pixels, a stride of 256 pixels, and class-specific probability thresholds optimized via grid search to maximize F1-score. Although the model predicts multiple tissue classes, only TLS-predicted regions were retained for downstream analysis. To distinguish individual TLSs, clusters of connected TLS-positive pixels were extracted from the binary prediction mask using the ‘findContours’ function from the OpenCV package in Python. Each region was assigned a unique identifier based on its order of detection, and the corresponding spatial coordinates were stored for downstream analysis. In total, 21,955 TLSs were identified across all samples (LUSC, n=6,688; BLCA, n=2,538; KIRC, n=899; LUAD, n=6,049; STAD, n=3,484; COAD, n=2,297). To ensure accurate visualization and morphological assessment, spatial coordinates were mapped to WSIs and manually reviewed. For each TLS, the coordinates were retrieved and rasterized into a binary mask using the ‘fillPoly’ function from the OpenCV package. This mask was then used to extract the corresponding area from the whole-slide image, and the bounding rectangle was computed using the ‘boundingRect’ function in OpenCV to segment the TLSs. As with TLSs identified in ST data, TLS size in WSIs was calculated by determining the number of pixels in each segmented H&E image, where each pixel corresponds to an area of 0.25 × 0.25 μm2. The total area of each TLS was then computed by multiplying the pixel count by 0.0625 μm2.

chinese.text: LUSC、KIRC、BLCA、LUAD、STAD 和 COAD WSI 是从基因组数据共享 (GDC) 门户 (115) (https://portal.gdc.cancer.gov/) 获得的，并经过处理以识别和分类 TLS 成熟状态。 TLS 检测是使用 HookNet-TLS (47) 进行的，HookNet-TLS 是一种基于深度学习的分割模型，旨在检测组织病理学图像中的 TLS。该模型以两种分辨率（高（0.5 μm/像素）和低（2.0 μm/像素））作为输入 WSI，以及指示有效组织区域的二进制组织掩模。使用默认参数，包括 512 × 512 像素的补丁大小、256 像素的步幅以及通过网格搜索优化的特定于类别的概率阈值，以最大化 F1 分数。尽管该模型预测多个组织类别，但仅保留 TLS 预测区域用于下游分析。为了区分各个 TLS，使用 Python 中 OpenCV 包中的“findContours”函数从二进制预测掩模中提取连接的 TLS 正像素簇。每个区域都根据其检测顺序分配一个唯一的标识符，并存储相应的空间坐标以供下游分析。所有样本总共鉴定出 21,955 个 TLS（LUSC，n=6,688；BLCA，n=2,538；KIRC，n=899；LUAD，n=6,049；STAD，n=3,484；COAD，n=2,297）。为了确保准确的可视化和形态评估，将空间坐标映射到 WSI 并进行手动审查。对于每个 TLS，使用 OpenCV 包中的“fillPoly”函数检索坐标并将其光栅化为二进制掩码。然后使用该掩模从整个幻灯片图像中提取相应的区域，并使用 OpenCV 中的“boundingRect”函数计算边界矩形以分割 TLS。与 ST 数据中识别的 TLS 一样，WSI 中的 TLS 大小是通过确定每个分割的 H&E 图像中的像素数来计算的，其中每个像素对应于 0.25 × 0.25 μm2 的区域。然后通过将像素数乘以 0.0625 μm2 计算每个 TLS 的总面积。

Although the model predicts multiple tissue classes, only TLS-predicted regions were retained for downstream analysis. To distinguish individual TLSs, clusters of connected TLS-positive pixels were extracted from the binary prediction mask using the ‘findContours’ function from the OpenCV package in Python. Each region was assigned a unique identifier based on its order of detection, and the corresponding spatial coordinates were stored for downstream analysis. In total, 21,955 TLSs were identified across all samples (LUSC, n=6,688; BLCA, n=2,538; KIRC, n=899; LUAD, n=6,049; STAD, n=3,484; COAD, n=2,297). To ensure accurate visualization and morphological assessment, spatial coordinates were mapped to WSIs and manually reviewed. english.text: Following TLS detection, a two-step YOLOv8-based classification pipeline (48) was developed to categorize TLSs by maturation states. The model was trained on a subset of data from three TCGA cohorts (LUSC, BLCA, and KIRC), comprising 956 TLS images. To reduce batch effects due to differences in staining, slide scanning, and tissue pro cessing, YOLOv8 was trained using the default data augmentation parameters, including flips, rotations, scaling, cutout, mix-up, brightness and contrast shifts, hue and saturation jitter, and Gaussian blur and noise. In the first step, TLSs were classified as E-TLS or mTLS. In the second step, mTLSs were further sub-classified into P-TLSs and S-TLSs. Two separate classifiers were trained, one for E-TLS vs. mTLS and another for P-TLS vs. S-TLS. For each cancer type, TLS images were manually annotated, stratified by cancer type, and randomly split into 80% training and 20% test sets. Models were trained using image-based features extracted from the segmented TLSs. Both classifiers were trained for 200 epochs using stochastic gradient descent with momentum and cosine learning-rate scheduling. Performance was evaluated on the held-out 20% test sets using accuracy, precision, recall, and F1-score, with training and test loss and accuracy monitored across epochs to confirm stable convergence. Specifically, precision measured the proportion of correctly predicted positive instances out of all predicted positives, recall measured the proportion of correctly predicted positives out of all actual positives, and F1-score represented the harmonic mean of precision and recall. The numbers of training and testing images for each cancer type, along with a summary of classification metrics, are provided in
fig. S5
, A, B, and D.

chinese.text: 在 TLS 检测之后，开发了一个基于 YOLOv8 的两步分类管道 (48)，以按成熟状态对 TLS 进行分类。该模型使用来自三个 TCGA 队列（LUSC、BLCA 和 KIRC）的数据子集进行训练，其中包含 956 张 TLS 图像。为了减少由于染色、载玻片扫描和组织处理差异造成的批次效应，YOLOv8 使用默认的数据增强参数进行训练，包括翻转、旋转、缩放、剪切、混合、亮度和对比度偏移、色调和饱和度抖动以及高斯模糊和噪声。第一步，TLS 被分类为 E-TLS 或 mTLS。第二步，mTLS 进一步细分为 P-TLS 和 S-TLS。训练了两个单独的分类器，一个用于 E-TLS 与 mTLS，另一个用于 P-TLS 与 S-TLS。对于每种癌症类型，TLS 图像均经过手动注释、按癌症类型分层，并随机分为 80% 的训练集和 20% 的测试集。使用从分段 TLS 中提取的基于图像的特征来训练模型。两个分类器都使用动量和余弦学习率调度的随机梯度下降训练了 200 个时期。使用准确度、精确度、召回率和 F1 分数在保留的 20% 测试集上评估性能，并在各个时期监控训练和测试损失以及准确度，以确认稳定的收敛。具体来说，精确度测量了正确预测的正例在所有预测正例中的比例，召回率测量了正确预测的正例在所有实际正例中的比例，F1 分数表示精度和召回率的调和平均值。图 2 提供了每种癌症类型的训练和测试图像的数量以及分类指标的摘要。 S5、A、B 和 D。

For each cancer type, TLS images were manually annotated, stratified by cancer type, and randomly split into 80% training and 20% test sets. Both classifiers were trained for 200 epochs using stochastic gradient descent with momentum and cosine learning-rate scheduling. english.text: To directly evaluate the cross-cancer generalizability of the YOLOv8based TLS maturation classifier, we applied the trained YOLO model to matched H&E images from our combined ST cohorts. Importantly, none of these H&E images were included in model training and were therefore entirely unseen by YOLO. Model predictions were evaluated against ST-based TLS annotations. No retraining, fine-tuning, or threshold recalibration was performed; the model was applied as-is using the same preprocessing steps, parameter values, and operating thresholds learned during training, ensuring a stringent and unbiased assessment of generalizability. Following the same two-step workflow used throughout the manuscript, E-TLSs were first distinguished from mature TLSs (mTLSs), after which mTLSs were further subclassified into P-TLSs and S-TLSs. Model performance was quantified using accuracy, precision, recall, and F1 score, with receiver operating characteristic (ROC) and precision–recall analyses used to assess discriminative performance under class imbalance.

chinese.text: 为了直接评估基于 YOLOv8 的 TLS 成熟分类器的跨癌症泛化性，我们将经过训练的 YOLO 模型应用于来自组合 ST 队列的匹配 H&E 图像。重要的是，这些 H&E 图像均未包含在模型训练中，因此 YOLO 完全看不到。根据基于 ST 的 TLS 注释评估模型预测。未进行重新训练、微调或阈值重新校准；该模型使用训练期间学到的相同预处理步骤、参数值和操作阈值按原样应用，确保对普遍性进行严格且公正的评估。按照整个手稿中使用的相同的两步工作流程，E-TLS 首先与成熟的 TLS（mTLS）区分开来，之后 mTLS 进一步细分为 P-TLS 和 S-TLS。使用准确度、精确度、召回率和 F1 分数来量化模型性能，并使用接受者操作特征 (ROC) 和精确召回分析来评估类别不平衡下的判别性能。

sections.title_zh: 治疗相关 WSI 队列

english.text: To characterize TLS maturation in therapy-associated settings, four independent clinical cohorts spanning immunotherapy, targeted therapy, chemotherapy, and combined chemo-targeted regimens were analyzed (43–46). An independent in-house OCCC cohort included 34 platinumresistant patients treated with combined anti–CTLA-4 and anti–PD-1/ PD-L1 immunotherapy, with high-resolution H&E images available for 26 patients (25 pretreatment and 14 on-treatment samples) (43). Two breast cancer cohorts consisted of diagnostic biopsy H&E slides collected before neoadjuvant systemic therapy. The HER2-targeted therapy cohort included 85 HER2+ invasive breast carcinoma cases confirmed by ASCO/CAP IHC/ISH criteria, with treatment response defined as pathological complete response versus residual invasive disease. Patients received neoadjuvant trastuzumab ± pertuzumab; 37 patients were responders and 48 patients were non-responders (46). The neoadjuvant chemotherapy cohort comprised 197 patients prospectively enrolled into the TransNEO study and treated with block-sequential taxane plus anthracycline for a median of 18 weeks, with response evaluated using the Residual Cancer Burden (RCB) system, yielding 57 responders and 140 non-responders (45). The ovarian cancer cohort consisted of post-treatment surgical resection H&E slides from 78 highgrade serous ovarian cancer (HGSOC) patients treated with carboplatin/ paclitaxel plus bevacizumab. Response was assessed using posttreatment CA-125 kinetics and measurable tumor regression, identifying 26 responders and 52 non-responders (44). All H&E images were processed using the same pipeline described above. Across these cohorts, we identified 3,133 TLSs in total [OCCC, n=91 (43); HGSOC, n=2,236 (44); BRCA, n=503 (45); BRCA, n=303 (46)]. By maturation state, this included 1,346 E-TLSs [OCCC, n=70 (43); HGSOC (44), n=799; BRCA, n=267 (45); BRCA, n=210 (46)], 1,627 P-TLSs [OCCC, n=18 (43); HGSOC (44), n=1,326; BRCA, n=201 (45); BRCA, n=82 (46)], and 160 S-TLSs [OCCC, n=3 (43); HGSOC (44), n=111; BRCA, n=35 (45); BRCA, n=11 (46)].

chinese.text: 为了表征治疗相关环境中 TLS 的成熟，对涵盖免疫治疗、靶向治疗、化疗和联合化疗靶向方案的四个独立临床队列进行了分析 (43-46)。一个独立的内部 OCCC 队列包括 34 名接受抗 CTLA-4 和抗 PD-1/PD-L1 联合免疫治疗的铂类耐药患者，其中 26 名患者可获得高分辨率 H&E 图像（25 名治疗前样本和 14 名治疗中样本）(43)。两个乳腺癌队列由新辅助全身治疗前收集的诊断性活检 H&E 切片组成。 HER2靶向治疗队列包括85例经ASCO/CAP IHC/ISH标准证实的HER2+浸润性乳腺癌病例，治疗反应定义为病理完全缓解与残留浸润性疾病。患者接受新辅助曲妥珠单抗±帕妥珠单抗； 37 名患者有反应，48 名患者无反应 (46)。新辅助化疗队列由前瞻性纳入 TransNEO 研究的 197 名患者组成，并接受组序贯紫杉烷加蒽环类药物治疗，中位时间为 18 周，并使用残余癌症负担 (RCB) 系统评估疗效，产生 57 名有反应者和 140 名无反应者 (45)。卵巢癌队列由 78 名接受卡铂/紫杉醇加贝伐单抗治疗的高级别浆液性卵巢癌 (HGSOC) 患者的治疗后手术切除 H&E 切片组成。使用治疗后 CA-125 动力学和可测量的肿瘤消退来评估疗效，确定 26 名有反应者和 52 名无反应者 (44)。所有 H&E 图像均使用上述相同的流程进行处理。在这些队列中，我们总共识别出 3,133 个 TLS [OCCC，n=91 (43)； HGSOC，n=2,236 (44)； BRCA，n=503 (45)； BRCA，n=303 (46)]。按照成熟状态，这包括 1,346 个 E-TLS [OCCC，n=70 (43)； HGSOC (44)，n=799； BRCA，n=267 (45)； BRCA，n=210 (46)]，1,627 个 P-TLS [OCCC，n=18 (43)； HGSOC (44)，n=1,326； BRCA，n=201 (45)； BRCA，n=82 (46)] 和 160 个 S-TLS [OCCC，n=3 (43)； HGSOC (44)，n=111； BRCA，n=35 (45)； BRCA，n=11 (46)]。

source_fragments: To characterize TLS maturation in therapy-associated settings, four independent clinical cohorts spanning immunotherapy, targeted therapy, chemotherapy, and combined chemo-targeted regimens were analyzed (43–46). An independent in-house OCCC cohort included 34 platinumresistant patients treated with combined anti–CTLA-4 and anti–PD-1/ PD-L1 immunotherapy, with high-resolution H&E images available for 26 patients (25 pretreatment and 14 on-treatment samples) (43). Two breast cancer cohorts consisted of diagnostic biopsy H&E slides collected before neoadjuvant systemic therapy. The HER2-targeted therapy cohort included 85 HER2+ invasive breast carcinoma cases confirmed by ASCO/CAP IHC/ISH criteria, with treatment response defined as pathological complete response versus residual invasive disease. Patients received neoadjuvant trastuzumab ± pertuzumab; 37 patients were responders and 48 patients were non-responders (46). The neoadjuvant chemotherapy cohort comprised 197 patients prospectively enrolled into the TransNEO study and treated with block-sequential taxane plus anthracycline for a median of 18 weeks, with response evaluated using the Residual Cancer Burden (RCB) system, yielding 57 responders and 140 non-responders (45). The ovarian cancer cohort consisted of post-treatment surgical resection H&E slides from 78 highgrade serous ovarian cancer (HGSOC) patients treated with carboplatin/ paclitaxel plus bevacizumab. Response was assessed using posttreatment CA-125 kinetics and measurable tumor regression, identifying 26 responders and 52 non-responders (44). All H&E images were processed using the same pipeline described above. Across these cohorts, we identified 3,133 TLSs in total [OCCC, n=91 (43); HGSOC, n=2,236 (44); BRCA, n=503 (45); BRCA, n=303 (46)]. By maturation state, this included 1,346 E-TLSs [OCCC, n=70 (43); HGSOC (44), n=799; BRCA, n=267 (45); BRCA, n=210 (46)], 1,627 P-TLSs [OCCC, n=18 (43); HGSOC (44), n=1,326; BRCA, n=201 (45); BRCA, n=82 (46)], and 160 S-TLSs [OCCC, n=3 (43); HGSOC (44), n=111; BRCA, n=35 (45); BRCA, n=11 (46)].

sections.title_zh: TLS 组分层

english.text: To assess the prognostic value of TLS maturation states, we computed a composite TLS score that integrates the relative contributions of each TLS state, E-TLS, P-TLS, and S-TLS, for each sample. Absolute counts of each TLS state were first quantified per sample, resulting in a distribution of TLS maturation states. To mitigate skewness and address overdispersion in the raw counts, we applied a log1p transformation to each state count. Samples lacking TLSs were assigned a composite score of zero to reflect the absence of TLS formation. For TLS+ samples, we performed PCA on z-score normalized, log-transformed TLS state counts within each cancer cohort to identify dominant axes of variation. Each TLS+ sample was then projected into this PCA space, and a composite score was calculated as a weighted sum of the first two principal components (PC1 and PC2), with weights proportional to the variance explained by each component. This data-driven approach captures both the abundance and compositional diversity of TLS maturation in an orthogonal and continuous manner. For downstream survival analysis, all samples were stratified into C1 and C2 groups based on the median value of the composite TLS score.

chinese.text: 为了评估 TLS 成熟状态的预后价值，我们计算了一个综合 TLS 分数，该分数整合了每个样本的每个 TLS 状态、E-TLS、P-TLS 和 S-TLS 的相对贡献。首先对每个样本的每个 TLS 状态的绝对计数进行量化，从而得出 TLS 成熟状态的分布。为了减轻偏差并解决原始计数的过度分散问题，我们对每个状态计数应用了 log1p 转换。缺乏 TLS 的样品的综合得分为零，以反映不存在 TLS 形成。对于 TLS+ 样本，我们对每个癌症队列中 z 分数归一化、对数转换的 TLS 状态计数进行 PCA，以确定变异的主导轴。然后将每个 TLS+ 样本投影到该 PCA 空间中，并将综合得分计算为前两个主成分（PC1 和 PC2）的加权和，权重与每个成分解释的方差成正比。这种数据驱动的方法以正交和连续的方式捕获 TLS 成熟的丰度和成分多样性。对于下游生存分析，根据综合 TLS 评分的中值将所有样本分为 C1 和 C2 组。

source_fragments: To assess the prognostic value of TLS maturation states, we computed a composite TLS score that integrates the relative contributions of each TLS state, E-TLS, P-TLS, and S-TLS, for each sample. Absolute counts of each TLS state were first quantified per sample, resulting in a distribution of TLS maturation states. To mitigate skewness and address overdispersion in the raw counts, we applied a log1p transformation to each state count. Samples lacking TLSs were assigned a composite score of zero to reflect the absence of TLS formation. For TLS+ samples, we performed PCA on z-score normalized, log-transformed TLS state counts within each cancer cohort to identify dominant axes of variation. Each TLS+ sample was then projected into this PCA space, and a composite score was calculated as a weighted sum of the first two principal components (PC1 and PC2), with weights proportional to the variance explained by each component. This data-driven approach captures both the abundance and compositional diversity of TLS maturation in an orthogonal and continuous manner. For downstream survival analysis, all samples were stratified into C1 and C2 groups based on the median value of the composite TLS score.

sections.title_zh: 生存分析

english.text: Survival analysis was performed to assess the association between TLS maturation states and OS across different cancer types. KM survival curves were generated using the ‘Surv’ and ‘survfit’ functions from the survival package (116) in R, and statistical differences between groups were assessed via the log-rank test. For TCGA cohorts, clinical annotations and OS times were obtained from the PanCanAtlas study (117). To estimate the impact of TLS maturation on survival while adjusting for potential confounders, including tumor stage, multivariable Cox proportional hazards models were fit using the ‘coxph’ function from the survival package (116), from which hazard ratios (HRs) and 95% confidence intervals (CIs) were computed.

chinese.text: 进行生存分析以评估 TLS 成熟状态与不同癌症类型的 OS 之间的关联。 KM 生存曲线是使用 R 中生存包 (116) 中的“Surv”和“survfit”函数生成的，并通过对数秩检验评估组间的统计差异。对于 TCGA 队列，临床注释和 OS 时间是从 PanCanAtlas 研究中获得的 (117)。为了估计 TLS 成熟对生存的影响，同时调整包括肿瘤分期在内的潜在混杂因素，使用生存包中的“coxph”函数拟合多变量 Cox 比例风险模型 (116)，从中计算风险比 (HR) 和 95% 置信区间 (CI)。

KM survival curves were generated using the ‘Surv’ and ‘survfit’ functions from the survival package (116) in R, and statistical differences between groups were assessed via the log-rank test. For TCGA cohorts, clinical annotations and OS times were obtained from the PanCanAtlas study (117). To estimate the impact of TLS maturation on survival while adjusting for potential confounders, including tumor stage, multivariable Cox proportional hazards models were fit using the ‘coxph’ function from the survival package (116), from which hazard ratios (HRs) and 95% confidence intervals (CIs) were computed.

sections.title_zh: 额外的统计分析

english.text: In addition to the algorithms described above, all other basic statistical analyses were performed in the R statistical environment (v4.3.0, v4.4.1). Enrichment across various conditions was assessed using a chi-square test on observed counts, followed by calculation of standardized and adjusted residuals to quantify deviations from expected values. Ad justed residuals were used to highlight significant patterns, with corresponding P-values indicating statistically significant enrichment or depletion across different conditions within the dataset. Pairwise comparisons of gene expression were conducted using the Wilcoxon ranksum test to assess statistical significance between TLS maturation states. Spearman’s correlation coefficient was used to evaluate the association between two continuous variables, such as distance from TLSs and pathway scores in tumor spots. The correlation matrix was generated using the ‘cor’ function with the 'spearman' method in R. Proportion tests were conducted separately for each TLS maturation state to examine its relationship with clinical features. All statistical tests in this study were two-sided. To account for multiple hypothesis testing, P-values were adjusted using the Benjamini-Hochberg method to calculate false discovery rate (FDR) q-values. Results were considered statistically significant at a P-value or FDR q-value threshold of <0.05.

chinese.text: 除了上述算法外，所有其他基本统计分析均在 R 统计环境（v4.3.0、v4.4.1）中进行。使用观察计数的卡方检验评估各种条件下的富集，然后计算标准化和调整残差以量化与预期值的偏差。调整后的残差用于突出显着模式，相应的 P 值表明数据集中不同条件下统计上显着的富集或消耗。使用 Wilcoxon 秩和检验进行基因表达的成对比较，以评估 TLS 成熟状态之间的统计显着性。 Spearman 相关系数用于评估两个连续变量之间的关联，例如距 TLS 的距离和肿瘤点的通路评分。相关矩阵是使用 R 中的“cor”函数和“spearman”方法生成的。对每个 TLS 成熟状态分别进行比例测试，以检查其与临床特征的关系。本研究中的所有统计检验都是双面的。为了考虑多重假设检验，使用 Benjamini-Hochberg 方法调整 P 值以计算错误发现率 (FDR) q 值。当 P 值或 FDR q 值阈值 <0.05 时，结果被认为具有统计显着性。

english.text: Editor’s summary Tertiary lymphoid structures (TLSs) form local immune hubs inside tumors, but they are diverse and not all are equally functional. Cho et al. built a pan-cancer atlas and developed an artificial intelligence (AI)–based framework to detect and characterize TLSs in human tumors. TLSs varied in maturation state, spatial location, cellular composition and organization. Intratumoral TLSs were associated with spatial gradients in tumor-intrinsic signaling. A scalable model was trained to detect and classify TLSs on standard pathology slides, and a composition-based TLS score was designed to stratify patients based upon survival outcomes. The study provides insights into TLS biology and may offer a path toward integrating TLS features into future clinical trials. —Priscilla N. Kelly

assets.title_zh: 图1：TLS检测与分析的研究设计和流程
assets.intro: 说明12癌种空间数据、TLS自动识别、成熟与位置标注及下游分析。。本图不是孤立的结果展示，而是正文从前一层证据进入下一层分析的连接节点。
assets.caption_en: Fig. 1. Study design and workflow for TLS detection and analysis. (A) Schematic of the study design. TCGA cancer type abbreviations are used. (B) Overview of the analysis workflow (see materials and methods). Data are input into iStar (25), and a TLS signature score is calculated based on our previously reported TLS signature (25). Unsupervised clustering is performed to extract TLS regions, followed by TLS segmentation. Gene expression data are extracted simultaneously for each TLS and TLS IDs are automatically assigned, followed by maturation inference, spatial location identification, and downstream analyses. IT, TLS within tumor tissue. PT, TLS within two spots (200 μm) of tumor. DT, TLS greater than two spots from tumor. (C) (Left) Fractions of samples with or without TLS. (Right) Number of TLS+ samples across 12 cancer types. (D) (Left) Average TLS size. (Right) Number of TLS per sample by cancer type. (E) (Left) Proportion of TLSs by spatial location. (Right) Relative fractions of TLS locations across cancer types. ***P < 0.001; **P < 0.01; *P < 0.05; P values were calculated using Pearson's χ2 test. In (D, E) right panels, cancer types with > 5 TLS+ samples were included. distributed relatively evenly across the three categories, with 214 IT, 231 PT, and 250 DT TLSs identified, although their relative proportions varied by cancer type (Fig. 1E and table S4). LUAD and CSCC showed higher fractions of IT TLSs, whereas BRCA was enriched for PT TLSs, and LIHC, colorectal cancer (CRC), BLCA, KIRC, and PAAD exhibited higher fractions of DT TLSs. Together, these analyses reveal pronounced heterogeneity in TLS prevalence, size, and spatial organization across cancers, underscoring the diverse architectural patterns of TLSs within the TME.
assets.caption_zh: 图 1. TLS 检测和分析的研究设计和工作流程。 (A) 研究设计示意图。使用 TCGA 癌症类型缩写。 (B) 分析工作流程概述（参见材料和方法）。数据被输入 iStar (25)，并根据我们之前报告的 TLS 签名 (25) 计算 TLS 签名分数。执行无监督聚类来提取 TLS 区域，然后进行 TLS 分割。每个 TLS 同时提取基因表达数据，并自动分配 TLS ID，然后进行成熟度推断、空间位置识别和下游分析。 IT，肿瘤组织内的 TLS。肿瘤两个点 (200 μm) 内的 PT、TLS。 DT、TLS 距离肿瘤大于两个点。 (C)（左）具有或不具有 TLS 的样品分数。 （右）12 种癌症类型的 TLS+ 样本数量。 (D)（左）平均 TLS 大小。 （右）按癌症类型划分的每个样本的 TLS 数量。 (E)（左）按空间位置划分的 TLS 比例。 （右）不同癌症类型的 TLS 位置的相对分数。 ***P < 0.001； **P<0.01； *P<0.05； P 值使用 Pearson χ2 检验计算。在 (D、E) 右图中，包括具有 > 5 个 TLS+ 样本的癌症类型。在这三个类别中分布相对均匀，确定了 214 个 IT、231 个 PT 和 250 个 DT TLS，尽管它们的相对比例因癌症类型而异（图 1E 和表 S4）。 LUAD 和 CSCC 显示出较高比例的 IT TLS，而 BRCA 富含 PT TLS，而 LIHC、结直肠癌 (CRC)、BLCA、KIRC 和 PAAD 显示出较高比例的 DT TLS。总之，这些分析揭示了癌症中 TLS 患病率、大小和空间组织的显着异质性，强调了 TME 中 TLS 的不同架构模式。

assets.caption_en: Fig. 2. Systematic classification and spatial profiling of TLS maturation states. (A) Workflow for TLS maturation classification. TLSs are first divided into early (E-TLS) and mature TLSs (mTLS) based on the presence of follicular dendritic cells (FDCs). FDC+ TLSs are further categorized as P-TLS or secondary follicle-like TLS (S-TLS) depending on germinal center (GC) presence. Pie chart displays the proportions and counts of each maturation state. (B) Representative examples of E-TLS, P-TLS, and S-TLS, each with an H&E image and corresponding heatmaps showing differential expression of TLS score and six marker genes used for maturation classification. Scale bar, 100 μm. (C) Differential expression of TLS score and six marker genes across three TLS maturation states. All TLSs are included. P-values from Wilcoxon rank-sum tests are shown. (D) Cross-platform validation of TLS maturation state assignments using ST (Visium ST) and SP (COMET seqIF). Representative E-TLS, P-TLS, and S-TLS examples are shown from adjacent tissue sections of the same tumors. Top row (Visium ST), left to right: H&E image, TLS signature score, cell colocalization map, and cell-type signature scores for B cells, T cells, FDCs, and germinal center B cells. Bottom row (COMET), left to right: merged immunofluorescence composite and single-channel images for CD20 (B cells), CD3ε (T cells), CD21 (FDCs), and BCL6/Ki67 (GC), highlighting a CD21+ reticular pattern in mTLSs. Scale bar, 100 μm. (E, H, and I) Relative fractions of TLS maturation states across spatial locations (E), cancer types (H), and combined characterization of TLSs by maturation state and spatial location (I). (F) Boxplots comparing the TLS size across maturation states. P values from Wilcoxon rank sum tests are shown. (G) TLS counts by maturation state across cancer types. Bar plots and pie charts illustrate the distributions. Cancer types with >1 TLS were included. ***P < 0.001; **P < 0.01; *P < 0.05; P values were calculated by Pearson's χ2 test. mature TLSs couple immune activation with regulatory restraint. Upregulation of stress-response genes (e.g., HSPA1A/B, HSPA6/8, HSPD1, BAG3, DNAJB1/4) in S-TLSs further suggests metabolic adaptation accompanying sustained immune activation (21, 28, 31, 32) (fig. S3D).
assets.caption_zh: Fig. 2. Systematic classification and spatial profiling of TLS maturation states. (B) E-TLS、P-TLS 和 S-TLS 的代表性示例，每个示例都有 H&E 图像和相应的热图，显示 TLS 评分的差异表达和用于成熟分类的六个标记基因。比例尺，100 μm。 (C) Differential expression of TLS score and six marker genes across three TLS maturation states.包括所有 TLS。显示了 Wilcoxon 秩和检验的 P 值。 (D) 使用 ST (Visium ST) 和 SP (COMET seqIF) 对 TLS 成熟状态分配进行跨平台验证。 Representative E-TLS, P-TLS, and S-TLS examples are shown from adjacent tissue sections of the same tumors.顶行 (Visium ST)，从左到右：H&E 图像、TLS 特征评分、细胞共定位图以及 B 细胞、T 细胞、FDC 和生发中心 B 细胞的细胞类型特征评分。底行 (COMET)，从左到右：CD20（B 细胞）、CD3ε（T 细胞）、CD21（FDC）和 BCL6/Ki67（GC）的合并免疫荧光复合图像和单通道图像，突出显示 mTLS 中的 CD21+ 网状图案。比例尺，100 μm。 （E、H 和 I）跨空间位置 (E)、癌症类型 (H) 的 TLS 成熟状态的相对分数，以及按成熟状态和空间位置 (I) 进行的 TLS 综合表征。 (F) Boxplots comparing the TLS size across maturation states.显示了 Wilcoxon 秩和检验的 P 值。 (G) TLS 按癌症类型的成熟状态进行计数。条形图和饼图说明了分布情况。 TLS > 1 的癌症类型也包括在内。 ***P < 0.001； **P<0.01； *P<0.05； P值通过Pearson χ2检验计算。成熟的 TLS 将免疫激活与监管限制结合起来。 S-TLS 中应激反应基因（例如 HSPA1A/B、HSPA6/8、HSPD1、BAG3、DNAJB1/4）的上调进一步表明伴随持续免疫激活的代谢适应（21,28,31,32）（图 S3D）。

(A) Heatmaps showing differential expression of key lineage markers, cell states, signaling pathways, cytokines, and chemokines across E-TLS, P-TLS, and S-TLS. Shown are markers for major TLS components, including B cell and T cell subsets, proliferative programs, and immunoregulatory cytokines and chemokines. Bn, naïve B cell; Bm, memory B cell; Tn, naïve T cell; Tcm, central memory T cell; Teff, effector T cell; Tfh, T follicular helper cell; Treg, regulatory T cell. (B) PC dissemination and antibody isotype distribution across TLS maturation states in ccRCC. TLSs were identified by PNAd, CD20, CD23, and BCL6 and outlined with yellow dashed lines. White squares indicate regions shown at higher magnification in E-TLS (top), P-TLS (middle), and S-TLS (bottom). Scale bar, 100 μm. (C) Spatial mapping of IL10+ B cells (Breg-like) within TLSs using Xenium 5K in lung adenocarcinoma. Two representative Xenium 5K ST fields are shown. From left to right: whole-TLS single-cell maps with annotated cell types. Corresponding zoomed-in regions highlight Breg-like cells within mature TLSs; maps show IL10 coexpression with CD24 and/or CD1D within individual B cells; and higher-magnification views highlight transcripts of IL10 and CD24 within Breg-like cells. Scale bars, 100 μm (left) and 10 μm (middle).

assets.caption_en: Fig. 4. Spatial dynamics of tumor pathway activity relative to TLS proximity. (A) Schematic illustrating an IT TLS (left) and how the distance between its center and nearby tumor regions is measured (right). (B) Bar plots showing correlations between the top 10 enriched pathways in tumor regions and their distance from IT TLS. “High-to-low” pathways exhibit high expression near TLS that decreases with distance, whereas “low-to-high” pathways show the opposite trend. Pie charts indicate cancer types associated with each enrichment trend. (C) Heat maps displaying spatial expression dynamics of pathway scores across tumor regions ordered by proximity to IT TLS (left, proximal; right, distal) in four representative cancer types. Pathways are hierarchically clustered into “high-to-low” (top) and “low-to-high” (bottom) groups. Numbered and color-coded annotations indicate the top 10 pathways. (D) Line plots showing expression dynamics of the top 10 pathways [from (C)] across tumor distance from IT TLS in eight cancer types. Each line represents a different cancer type. (E) Representative examples of distance-dependent expression changes for TLS-associated cytokines and chemokines (TNFSF14, CXCL11, CXCL16, CXCL10) across eight cancer types. (F) Representative spatial maps from a Xenium tumor sample (left to right): whole-slide H&E image, IT TLS map, and zoomed-in spatial cell type maps for four representative TLSs (1 to 4), showing distinct immune and stromal compartments with major cell types annotated. (G) Representative Xenium ST map highlighting selected TLS-1 (left) and TLS-2 (right) from (F) and higher-magnification views of boxed regions from each TLS (middle), displaying cell boundaries overlaid with transcript expression for TLS-associated chemokines (TNFSF14, CXCL16, CXCR6, CXCL10, CXCL11, CXCR3). For (D) and (E), the x axes show distance from IT TLS (proximal to distal), and the y axes show normalized signature score (z-score). contrast, LUSC, LUAD, BLCA, and COAD [microsatellite instability high (MSI-H)] did not exhibit a consistent pattern (fig. S7A). When cohorts were combined, TLS maturation-state distributions shifted significantly across stages I to III, whereas stage IV tumors showed substantial overlap and no further separation (Fig. 6D). Overall, TLS maturation frequently, but not uniformly, tracks with tumor stage, with the association most evident in early-to-intermediate stages.
assets.caption_zh: 图 4. 肿瘤通路活性相对于 TLS 邻近度的空间动态。 (A) 示意图，说明 IT TLS（左）以及如何测量其中心与附近肿瘤区域之间的距离（右）。 (B) 条形图显示肿瘤区域中前 10 个富集通路与其与 IT TLS 的距离之间的相关性。 “从高到低”途径在 TLS 附近表现出高表达，并随着距离的增加而降低，而“从低到高”途径则显示出相反的趋势。饼图显示与每种富集趋势相关的癌症类型。 (C) 热图显示了四种代表性癌症类型中肿瘤区域通路评分的空间表达动态，按与 IT TLS 的接近程度（左、近端；右、远端）排序。路径按层次分为“从高到低”（顶部）和“从低到高”（底部）组。编号和颜色编码注释指示前 10 个路径。 (D) 线图显示八种癌症类型中从 IT TLS 到肿瘤距离的前 10 条通路 [来自 (C)] 的表达动态。每条线代表不同的癌症类型。 (E) 八种癌症类型中 TLS 相关细胞因子和趋化因子（TNFSF14、CXCL11、CXCL16、CXCL10）的距离依赖性表达变化的代表性示例。 (F) Xenium 肿瘤样本的代表性空间图（从左到右）：全玻片 H&E 图像、IT TLS 图和四个代表性 TLS（1 至 4）的放大空间细胞类型图，显示不同的免疫和基质区室，并注释了主要细胞类型。 (G) 代表性 Xenium ST 图突出显示 (F) 中选定的 TLS-1（左）和 TLS-2（右）以及每个 TLS 的盒装区域的高倍放大视图（中），显示覆盖有 TLS 相关趋化因子（TNFSF14、CXCL16、CXCR6、CXCL10、CXCL11、CXCR3）转录表达的细胞边界。对于 (D) 和 (E)，x 轴显示距 IT TLS 的距离（近端到远端），y 轴显示标准化签名分数（z 分数）。相比之下，LUSC、LUAD、BLCA 和 COAD [微卫星不稳定性高 (MSI-H)] 没有表现出一致的模式（图 S7A）。当队列合并时，TLS 成熟状态分布在 I 期至 III 期之间显着变化，而 IV 期肿瘤显示出大量重叠并且没有进一步分离（图 6D）。总体而言，TLS 的成熟经常（但不均匀）与肿瘤分期相关，其中这种关联在早期到中期阶段最为明显。

SSL: sessile serrated lesion, HP: hyperplastic polyp, TA: tubular adenoma, TVA: tubulovillous adenoma, Mets: Metastasis, No Mets: No metastasis. (C) Pathology annotation of tissue compartments from the original study (38). The bar plot shows the fractions of tissue compartments colocalized with TLSs by maturation state. (D) Heatmap depicting the relative enrichment of tissue compartments across TLS maturation states (Ro/e values). (E) Stacked bar plot showing the relative fractions of E-TLS, P-TLS, and S-TLS by tumor grade (G1 to G3). (F) Enrichment of TLS maturation states by KRAS mutation status (left) and metastases (right). (G to L) Primary liver cancer cohort (40). (G) Cohort overview. (H) TLS count and maturation states across patient samples (column), annotated with clinical and molecular features. [(I) and (J)] Tissue region annotations (tumor bed, boundary, nontumor; see materials and methods) [(I), top)] and TLS distribution across regions by maturation state, shown as a bar plot [(I), bottom)] and an Ro/e enrichment plot (J). (K) TLS maturation state distribution by HBV status. (L) Enrichment of TLS states by HBV infection status (left) and tumor stage (right). (M to Q) In-house BLCA cohort. (M) Cohort overview. (N) TLS count and maturation state distribution across samples (column), annotated with clinical and molecular features, including tumor stage (cStage pre), MTAP status, and treatment response. R, responder; NR, nonresponder. [(O) and (P)] Tissue compartments annotated by board-certified pathologists [(O), top]. TILs, tumor-infiltrating lymphocytes. TLS distribution between tumor and stroma by maturation state, shown as a bar plot [(O), bottom] and an Ro/e enrichment plot (P). (Q) Enrichment of TLS maturation states by status of MTAP (left) and chemotherapy response (right). MTAP+, MTAP WT; MTAP–, MTAP loss. For panels (C), (I), and (O), TLSs were annotated using our own workflow. For panels (D), (J), and (P), relative enrichment was calculated using Ro/e (see materials and methods). For panels (F), (L), and (Q), proportion tests did not show significant differences in TLS maturation state distributions across groups.

assets.title_en: Figure 6. AI-driven TLS classification and its prognostic relevance in TCGA cohorts
assets.title_zh: 图6：AI驱动的TLS分类及其在TCGA队列中的预后意义
assets.intro: 展示H&E模型、跨队列检测、成熟组成评分和患者分层。。本图不是孤立的结果展示，而是正文从前一层证据进入下一层分析的连接节点。
assets.caption_en: Fig. 6. AI-driven TLS classification and its prognostic relevance in TCGA cohorts. (A) Schematic overview of the AI-based TLS detection and classification frameworks applied to 3071 WSIs from 10 patient cohorts [TCGA: LUSC, KIRC, BLCA, LUAD, STAD, COAD; therapy cohorts: OCCC, HGSOC, and two BRCA cohorts (45, 46)]. Each WSI was tiled at multiple resolutions for analysis. TLSs were detected using a deep learning model (HookNet-TLS) (47), then segmented and automatically labeled using our custom workflow, yielding 25,088 individual TLS images. An AI model (YOLOv8) (48) was trained and then applied to classify TLSs into three maturation states: E-TLS, P-TLS, and S-TLS (see materials and methods) (48).
